<meta charset="utf-8">
<title>Manager of Intelligence · review</title>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Newsreader:ital,opsz,wght@0,6..72,400;0,6..72,500;0,6..72,600;1,6..72,400&family=IBM+Plex+Sans:wght@400;500;600&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: a fixed 1280×720 stage scaled to fit, one slide at a time, presenter chrome along the bottom.
   Same design system as the HKUST "Governed Autonomy" deck: paper + navy + ochre, Newsreader / Plex. */
:root{
  --paper:#ECEEF1; --stock:#F7F8FA; --raise:#FFFFFF;
  --ink:#10161F; --ink2:#48525F; --ink3:#7C8794;
  --rule:#C9D0D9; --rule2:#DFE4EA;
  --blue:#1B4F8A; --blue2:#5885B4; --blue-wash:#DEE7F1;
  --ochre:#8F5E0E; --ochre2:#C08A29; --ochre-wash:#F5E9D0;
  --teal:#1F6B63; --teal-wash:#DBEAE7;
  --plum:#6B3F72; --plum-wash:#EDE0EF;
  --onaccent:#FFFFFF;
  --shadow:rgba(16,22,31,.10);
  --chromeH:44px;
  --serif:"Newsreader","Iowan Old Style",Georgia,serif;
  --sans:"IBM Plex Sans",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --mono:"IBM Plex Mono",ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --paper:#0E1319; --stock:#161C24; --raise:#1D242D;
  --ink:#E9EDF2; --ink2:#A7B2BF; --ink3:#79848F;
  --rule:#2C353F; --rule2:#232B34;
  --blue:#7FAAD8; --blue2:#5C86B2; --blue-wash:#1A2836;
  --ochre:#D7A64A; --ochre2:#A97F2A; --ochre-wash:#2E2413;
  --teal:#5FB3A8; --teal-wash:#142623;
  --plum:#B98BC0; --plum-wash:#241A26;
  --onaccent:#0E1319;
  --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.5); color-scheme:dark;}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --paper:#0E1319; --stock:#161C24; --raise:#1D242D;
  --ink:#E9EDF2; --ink2:#A7B2BF; --ink3:#79848F;
  --rule:#2C353F; --rule2:#232B34;
  --blue:#7FAAD8; --blue2:#5C86B2; --blue-wash:#1A2836;
  --ochre:#D7A64A; --ochre2:#A97F2A; --ochre-wash:#2E2413;
  --teal:#5FB3A8; --teal-wash:#142623;
  --plum:#B98BC0; --plum-wash:#241A26;
  --onaccent:#0E1319;
  --shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.5); color-scheme:dark;}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
[hidden]{display:none!important}
html,body{height:100%}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);overflow:hidden}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
input{font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--rule)}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue);outline-offset:2px}
#viewport{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);bottom:calc(var(--chromeH) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));overflow:hidden;background:var(--paper)}
#stage{width:1280px;height:720px;position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform-origin:center center;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);background:var(--stock);box-shadow:0 10px 50px var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.slide{position:absolute;inset:0;padding:0 76px 50px;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.slide.on{display:flex;animation:rise .4s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.3,1) both}
@keyframes rise{from{opacity:.001;transform:translateY(9px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.slide.on{animation:none}
  *{transition-duration:.01ms !important;animation-duration:.01ms !important}}
.rail{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:22px 0 0;font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);flex:none}
.rail .seg{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.rail .line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--rule)}
.rail .ask{color:var(--ochre);font-weight:600}
h1{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:62px;line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.024em;text-wrap:balance}
h2{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:34px;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:-.019em;text-wrap:balance;max-width:32ch}
h3{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;font-size:24px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.014em}
.kicker{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:12px}
.kicker.o{color:var(--ochre)}
.sub{font-size:17px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);max-width:60ch;margin-top:14px}
.sub b{color:var(--ink)}
.src{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.07em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.6}
strong,b{font-weight:600}
em.o{font-style:normal;color:var(--ochre)}
.body{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:0;padding-top:16px}
.row{display:grid;gap:40px;flex:1;align-items:center;min-height:0}
.rulemark{width:96px;height:3px;background:var(--blue);margin-bottom:26px;animation:draw .7s .15s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1) both}
@keyframes draw{from{width:0}to{width:96px}}
.open{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding-bottom:12px;position:relative}
.open .partno{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px}
.time{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase}
.hint{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.hint::before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ochre2)}

/* cover */
.cover{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;position:relative}
.cover h1{font-size:92px;line-height:.98;max-width:12ch;letter-spacing:-.032em}
.cover .lede{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:25px;line-height:1.32;color:var(--ink2);max-width:44ch;margin-top:24px}
.coverfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:18px;margin-top:40px;gap:24px}
.coverfoot .nm{font-size:16px;line-height:1.5}
.coverfoot .nm span{color:var(--ink2)}
.coverfoot .mt{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);text-align:right;line-height:1.9}
.sprites{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:flex-end}

/* who */
.me{display:grid;grid-template-columns:270px 1fr;gap:46px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.mepic{position:relative;width:256px;height:256px;margin:14px 0 0 14px}
.mepic img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 0 1.5px var(--rule),0 8px 26px var(--shadow)}
.mepic::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;border:1px dashed var(--ochre2)}
.mepic::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-14px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--blue);clip-path:polygon(50% 50%,120% 0,120% 42%)}
.cred{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);margin-top:14px}
.cred .r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:18px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);align-items:baseline}
.cred .w{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.cred .d{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4}
.cred .d em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ink2);font-size:13.5px;display:block;margin-top:2px}
.pair{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;margin-top:16px;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.pair>div{padding:13px 16px}
.pair>div:first-child{border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}
.pair .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
.pair .a .t{color:var(--blue)} .pair .b .t{color:var(--ochre)}
.pair p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.pair p b{color:var(--ink)}

/* agenda */
.agenda{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;flex:1;justify-content:center}
.ag{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px 1fr 150px;gap:20px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);
  padding:12px 18px;transition:.16s;text-align:left;width:100%;border-left:3px solid var(--rule)}
.ag:hover{border-left-color:var(--blue)}
.ag.hot{border-left-color:var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.ag.brk{background:transparent;border-style:dashed;padding:7px 18px}
.ag .no{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--blue)}
.ag.hot .no{color:var(--ochre)}
.ag h4{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:2px}
.ag p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
.ag .tm{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);text-align:right}
.thread{margin-top:12px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--stock);padding:16px 22px}
.thread .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.7;margin-bottom:6px}
.thread p{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.3}
.thread p em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ochre2)}

/* buttons, chips, tabs */
.btn{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:10px 15px;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;transition:.15s;text-align:left}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.btn.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--onaccent)}
.btn.go{background:var(--ochre);border-color:var(--ochre);color:var(--onaccent)}
.btn.right{background:var(--teal);border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--onaccent)}
.btn.wrong{opacity:.4}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tabs.col{flex-direction:column;flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:stretch}
.tabs.col .btn{width:100%}
.tabs .btn{flex:none}
[data-panel]{animation:pop .3s both}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:.001;transform:translateY(5px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.card{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:20px 22px}
.card .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.card p{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2)}
.card p+p{margin-top:10px}
.card p b{color:var(--ink)}
.card.warm{background:var(--ochre-wash);border-color:var(--ochre2)}
.card.warm .t{color:var(--ochre)}
.slab{background:var(--blue);color:var(--onaccent);padding:18px 22px}
.slab .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.8;margin-bottom:7px}
.slab p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.48}
.slab.warm{background:var(--ochre)}
.slab.ink{background:var(--ink);color:var(--stock)}
.big{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.big em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ochre)}
ul.dots{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px}
ul.dots li{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);padding-left:18px;position:relative}
ul.dots li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:8px;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue)}
ul.dots li b{color:var(--ink)}
ul.dots.o li::before{background:var(--ochre2)}

/* guess the number */
.guess{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.guess .btn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;padding:12px 26px;min-width:120px;text-align:center;font-weight:500}
.reveal{margin-top:26px;display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.answer{border-left:3px solid var(--ochre2);padding:6px 0 6px 18px;max-width:64ch}
.answer .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:44px;line-height:1;color:var(--ochre)}
.answer p{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px}
.answer p b{color:var(--ink)}

/* bars */
.bars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px}
.bar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.bar .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink2);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.4}
.bar .track{height:40px;background:var(--rule2);position:relative}
.bar .fill{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;transition:width 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1)}
.bar .lab{position:absolute;left:12px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;color:var(--onaccent);z-index:2;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.bar .lab.out{color:var(--ink)}
.fig{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:72px;line-height:1;font-weight:500;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fig.o{color:var(--ochre)} .fig.b{color:var(--blue)}
.figcap{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px}
.figcap b{color:var(--ink)}
.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.stats>div{padding:16px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.stats>div:last-child{border-right:0}
.stats .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:38px;line-height:1;color:var(--blue);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.stats .v.o{color:var(--ochre)}
.stats .k{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px}
.stats .s{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}

/* column chart (Stanford gap) */
.cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;align-items:end;height:300px;border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--ink3);padding:0 10px}
.gcol{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;height:100%}
.gcol .cv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;margin-bottom:8px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.gcol .cb{width:100%;max-width:120px;background:var(--blue2);transition:height 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1);height:0}
.gcol:last-child .cb{background:var(--ochre)}
.gcol:last-child .cv{color:var(--ochre)}
.collab{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:26px;padding:10px 10px 0}
.collab div{text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink2);text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.5}

/* eras */
.eras{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;border-top:2px solid var(--rule)}
.era{text-align:left;padding:16px 16px 18px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule2);position:relative;transition:.18s}
.era:last-child{border-right:0}
.era::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-7px;left:16px;width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--stock);border:2px solid var(--rule)}
.era .y{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:40px;line-height:1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.era .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:6px}
.era.on{background:var(--blue-wash)}
.era.on::before{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue)}
.era.on .y{color:var(--blue)}
.era.now .y{color:var(--ochre)}
.era.now.on{background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.era.now.on::before{background:var(--ochre2);border-color:var(--ochre2)}
.eradetail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:20px}

/* syntax vs imagination */
.code{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;line-height:1.6;background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:18px 20px;white-space:pre;overflow-x:auto;color:var(--ink2)}
.code .c{color:var(--ink3)} .code .k{color:var(--blue)} .code .s{color:var(--ochre)}
.prompt{background:var(--blue);color:var(--onaccent);padding:18px 22px;font-size:20px;line-height:1.4;font-family:var(--serif);border-radius:14px 14px 14px 2px;max-width:46ch}
.prompt.me{border-radius:14px 14px 2px 14px;margin-left:auto;background:var(--ink);color:var(--stock)}

/* flip cards */
.flips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;flex:1;align-content:center}
.flip{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:16px 20px;min-height:120px;transition:.2s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.flip:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.flip .when{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink3)}
.flip .q{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;line-height:1.2}
.flip .a{display:none;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2)}
.flip .a b{color:var(--ink)}
.flip.shown{border-left:3px solid var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.flip.shown .q{font-size:16px;color:var(--ink3);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-color:var(--ochre2)}
.flip.shown .a{display:block}
.flip.shown .when::after{content:" → October 2026";color:var(--ochre)}

/* ladder */
.ladder{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:420px;height:400px}
.ladder .rail2{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:6px;background:var(--ink3);border-radius:3px}
.rung{position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;height:50px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border:2px solid var(--blue);background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--blue);transition:.5s}
.rung.gone{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--ochre2);background:transparent;color:var(--ochre)}
.rung.new{background:var(--ochre);border-color:var(--ochre);color:var(--onaccent)}
.rung .who{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-left:10px;opacity:.85}

/* vote */
.vote{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:18px}
.vbtn{border:1.5px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:16px;text-align:left;transition:.15s}
.vbtn:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.vbtn .vl{font-size:17px;font-weight:600}
.vbtn .vn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:40px;line-height:1;color:var(--blue);margin-top:6px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.vbtn .vh{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:4px}

/* staff */
.staff{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 220px 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:14px 26px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.staff .p{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:14px 16px;display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center}
.staff .p .ic{width:44px;height:44px;flex:none;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--blue);font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
.staff .p h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
.staff .p p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink2)}
.staff .you{grid-row:1/3;grid-column:2;text-align:center;border:2px solid var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash);padding:26px 16px}
.staff .you .yt{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;color:var(--ochre)}
.staff .you p{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px;line-height:1.45}

/* concept explorer */
.explore{display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;gap:34px;flex:1;min-height:0;align-items:start}
.explore .tabs .btn{width:100%;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:10px}
.explore .tabs .btn small{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;opacity:.7;text-transform:uppercase}
.def{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.def .word{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:44px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.def .plain{font-size:18px;line-height:1.5;max-width:56ch}
.kv{display:grid;grid-template-columns:130px 1fr;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.kv>*{padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.kv .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;padding-top:14px}
.kv .v{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2)}
.kv .v b{color:var(--ink)}

/* doors */
.dims{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.doors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px;flex:1}
.door{border:1.5px solid var(--rule);padding:20px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--raise)}
.door.p{border-top:4px solid var(--blue)} .door.c{border-top:4px solid var(--ochre2)}
.door .dn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px}
.door.p .dn{color:var(--blue)} .door.c .dn{color:var(--ochre)}
.door .dt{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.door .ans{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:27px;line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:10px}
.door.p .ans{color:var(--blue)} .door.c .ans{color:var(--ochre)}
.door .why{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2)}
.verdict{margin-top:14px;padding:13px 20px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--stock);font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}

/* which door quiz */
.quiz{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;flex:1;align-content:center}
.qc{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:16px 18px;min-height:132px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;transition:.2s}
.qc:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.qc .qt{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.3}
.qc .qa{display:none;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.qc .tagd{display:none;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;align-self:flex-start;padding:4px 9px}
.qc.shown .qa,.qc.shown .tagd{display:block}
.qc.shown.d1{border-top:4px solid var(--blue)} .qc.shown.d1 .tagd{background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--blue)}
.qc.shown.d2{border-top:4px solid var(--ochre2)} .qc.shown.d2 .tagd{background:var(--ochre-wash);color:var(--ochre)}

/* path */
.steps{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.step{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:8px 10px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;text-align:left;max-width:120px;transition:.15s}
.step:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.step.on{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:var(--stock)}
.step.ai{border-left:3px solid var(--blue)}
.plane{margin-bottom:22px}
.plane .lh{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin-bottom:10px}
.plane .lt{font-size:16px;font-weight:600}

/* autonomy */
.levels{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:end;flex:1}
.lvl{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;transition:.18s}
.lvl:nth-child(1){min-height:200px}.lvl:nth-child(2){min-height:250px}.lvl:nth-child(3){min-height:300px}.lvl:nth-child(4){min-height:350px}
.lvl .ln{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.lvl h4{font-size:19px;font-weight:600}
.lvl .ex{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.lvl .ex b{color:var(--ink)}
.lvl .ct{margin-top:auto;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;color:var(--blue);line-height:1}
.lvl .ck{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.lvl:nth-child(4){border-color:var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.lvl:nth-child(4) .ln,.lvl:nth-child(4) .ct{color:var(--ochre)}

/* break */
.timer{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:180px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:-.04em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--blue)}

/* blocks */
.blocks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;align-items:stretch}
.blk{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:14px 16px;position:relative;transition:.18s}
.blk+.blk{border-left:0}
.blk .bn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.blk h4{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:28px;font-weight:500;margin-top:4px}
.blk .an{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:4px;line-height:1.4}
.blk.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue)}
.blk.on .bn,.blk.on h4,.blk.on .an{color:var(--onaccent)}
.blkgrow{display:flex;gap:0;margin:8px 0 18px}
.blkgrow span{flex:1;height:6px}
.blkgrow span:nth-child(1){background:var(--blue-wash)}.blkgrow span:nth-child(2){background:var(--blue2)}
.blkgrow span:nth-child(3){background:var(--blue)}.blkgrow span:nth-child(4){background:var(--ochre2)}
.blkbody{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}

/* compare table */
.cmp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px 1fr 1fr;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.cmp>div{padding:11px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.cmp .h{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink3)}
.cmp .h.b{color:var(--blue)} .cmp .h.o{color:var(--ochre)}
.cmp .rk{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}
.cmp .sk{background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--ink)}

/* demo */
.demo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 400px;gap:46px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.badge{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;padding:7px 13px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:14px}
.badge.p{background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--blue)} .badge.c{background:var(--ochre-wash);color:var(--ochre)}
.cmd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--stock);padding:10px 14px;display:inline-block;margin-top:16px}
.cmd b{color:var(--ochre2)}
.punch{margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:23px;line-height:1.28}
.punch em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ochre)}
.live{margin-top:18px;display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center}
.launch{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--ochre);color:var(--onaccent);padding:12px 20px;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;text-decoration:none;border:2px solid var(--ochre)}
.launch.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ochre)}
.launch:hover{opacity:.9}
.io{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 30px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-top:6px}
.io .box{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:12px 14px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2);min-height:96px}
.io .box .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:5px}
.io .arr{text-align:center;font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--ochre2);font-size:18px}

/* video */
.vid{background:var(--ink);aspect-ratio:16/9;width:100%;max-width:100%;position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.vid video{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background:var(--ink)}
.vid .fallback{position:absolute;inset:0;display:none;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:10px;color:var(--stock);text-align:center;padding:24px}
.vid.nofile .fallback{display:flex}
.vid.nofile video{visibility:hidden}
.vid .fallback b{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:500}
.vid .fallback span{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.7;line-height:1.7}

/* office */
.office{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#161228;overflow:hidden}
.office canvas{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;image-rendering:pixelated}
.officebar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:9px 13px;background:#1e1936;border-top:1px solid #2c2447}
.officebar .lb{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#7b729f;margin-right:auto}
.officebar button{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:#8d84b0;border:1px solid #3d3560;padding:5px 12px}
.officebar button.on{background:#1B4F8A;border-color:#1B4F8A;color:#fff}
.officecap{font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);font-style:italic;margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5}
.clip{position:relative;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#000;overflow:hidden}
.clip video{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000}
.clip-play{position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ochre2);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.clip-play::after{content:"";border-left:30px solid #fff;border-top:18px solid transparent;border-bottom:18px solid transparent;margin-left:8px}
.clip.playing .clip-play{display:none}

/* rules */
.ctrls{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.crow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 26px 260px;gap:18px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);align-items:center}
.crow .mine{font-size:15px;line-height:1.45}
.crow .arr{font-family:var(--mono);color:var(--ochre2);text-align:center}
.crow .bank{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;color:var(--blue)}

/* worry wall */
.wall{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;flex:1;align-content:center}
.worry{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:13px 16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:10px;align-items:center;transition:.15s;min-height:78px}
.worry:hover{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.worry .wq{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:19px;line-height:1.22}
.worry .wn{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink3);min-width:44px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.worry.hot{border-color:var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.worry.hot .wn{color:var(--ochre)}
.wallbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
.wallbar input{flex:1;padding:10px 12px;font-size:14px}

/* literacy layers */
.layers{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px}
.layer{text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:12px 16px;transition:.16s}
.layer .ln{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;color:var(--blue);line-height:1}
.layer h4{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:600}
.layer p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:2px}
.layer.on{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue)}
.layer.on .ln,.layer.on h4,.layer.on p{color:var(--onaccent)}
.paste{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.pq{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:11px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}
.pq .pt{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600}
.pq .pa{display:none;font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.pq.shown .pa{display:block}
.pq.shown.y{border-left:4px solid var(--teal)} .pq.shown.n{border-left:4px solid var(--ochre2)}
.pq .verd{display:none;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600}
.pq.shown .verd{display:inline}
.pq.y .verd{color:var(--teal)} .pq.n .verd{color:var(--ochre)}

/* answers */
.answers{display:grid;grid-template-columns:330px 1fr;gap:34px;flex:1;min-height:0;align-items:start;padding-top:8px}
.answers .tabs .btn{font-size:13.5px;padding:9px 12px;line-height:1.3}
.ansbody{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.ansbody .aq{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;line-height:1.15}
.ansbody .aa{font-size:17px;line-height:1.55;max-width:60ch}
.ansbody .aa b{color:var(--ochre)}
.echo{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
.echo button{border:1px solid var(--blue2);padding:5px 10px;color:var(--blue)}
.draft{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);border:1px dashed var(--ochre2);padding:3px 8px;align-self:flex-start}

/* checklist */
.kit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px;flex:1;align-content:center}
.kitem{text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise);padding:16px 18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 1fr;gap:14px}
.kitem .box{width:24px;height:24px;border:2px solid var(--blue2);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:14px;color:var(--onaccent)}
.kitem.done .box{background:var(--teal);border-color:var(--teal)}
.kitem .sk{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);font-weight:600}
.kitem h4{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;margin:3px 0 4px}
.kitem p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}

/* close */
.kill{text-wrap:balance;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:52px;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.022em;max-width:20ch}
.kill em{font-style:normal;color:var(--ochre)}
.srcs{columns:2;column-gap:40px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2)}
.srcs p{break-inside:avoid;margin-bottom:8px}
.srcs b{color:var(--ink)}

/* chrome */
#chrome{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:calc(var(--chromeH) + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));padding:0 18px env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);background:var(--paper);z-index:20}
#chrome .prog{flex:1;height:2px;background:var(--rule2);position:relative}
#chrome .prog i{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;background:var(--blue);transition:width .35s}
#chrome button{padding:5px 9px;border:1px solid var(--rule);font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
#chrome button:hover{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
#chrome .jump{display:flex;gap:4px}
#chrome .jump button.cur{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--onaccent)}
#count{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:var(--ink2);min-width:58px}
#secname{color:var(--blue);font-weight:600;min-width:150px}
#clock{color:var(--ochre);min-width:44px}
#notes{position:fixed;right:0;top:0;bottom:var(--chromeH);width:370px;background:var(--raise);border-left:1px solid var(--rule);padding:26px 26px 30px;overflow-y:auto;z-index:19;transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .3s}
#notes.open{transform:none}
#notes h5{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue);margin-bottom:14px}
#notes .nb{font-size:14px;line-height:1.62;color:var(--ink2)}
#notes .nb p{margin-bottom:12px}
#notes .nb b{color:var(--ink)}
#notes .tm{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--ochre);margin-bottom:14px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
#notes .cue{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--blue);border:1px solid var(--rule2);padding:9px 11px;margin-bottom:14px;line-height:1.6}
@media (max-width:820px){
  #chrome{gap:8px;padding-inline:10px;font-size:9.5px}
  #chrome #secname,#chrome .jump,#chrome #btnFull,#chrome #clock{display:none}
  #notes{width:100%}
}
/* 3 · three questions */
.q3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 446px;gap:46px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.qs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);margin-top:20px}
.qbtn{text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 1fr;gap:16px;padding:17px 0;
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);transition:.18s;width:100%}
.qbtn .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink3);padding-top:3px;
  transition:.18s}
.qbtn h4{font-size:20px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:4px;line-height:1.18;transition:.18s}
.qbtn p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.qbtn:hover h4{color:var(--blue2)}
.qbtn.on .n,.qbtn.on h4{color:var(--blue)}
.owner{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink3);margin-bottom:11px;font-weight:600}
.stack3{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.tier{border:1.5px solid var(--rule);padding:13px 16px;background:var(--raise);
  transition:border-color .4s,background .4s,opacity .4s}
.tier .tn{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2;transition:.4s}
.tier .tr{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.42;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:4px;transition:.4s}
.tier.own{border-color:var(--blue);background:var(--blue-wash)}
.tier.own .tn{color:var(--blue)}
.tier.share{border-color:var(--blue2)}
.tier.off{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.tier.off .tn,.tier.off .tr{color:var(--ochre)}
.moved{margin-top:15px;padding-left:14px;border-left:2px solid var(--rule);font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);min-height:44px}
.moved b{color:var(--ink)}
.moved.hot{border-left-color:var(--ochre2)}
.moved.hot b{color:var(--ochre)}
.gs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-top:13px}
.gs > div{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:12px 14px;background:var(--raise)}
.gs .hd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
.gs .gate .hd{color:var(--blue)} .gs .sensor .hd{color:var(--ochre)}
.gs p{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.gs p b{color:var(--ink)}

/* 4 perimeter */
.perwrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 306px;gap:44px;flex:1;align-items:center}
.field{position:relative;width:100%;height:396px}
.perim{position:absolute;border:2px solid var(--blue);background:var(--blue-wash);
  transition:all .85s cubic-bezier(.34,.8,.3,1)}
.perim .plab{position:absolute;top:-11px;left:16px;background:var(--stock);padding:0 8px;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--blue);font-weight:600}
.pill{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);white-space:nowrap;
  padding:8px 13px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;border:1.5px solid var(--ink3);
  background:var(--raise);color:var(--ink);z-index:3;
  transition:left .85s cubic-bezier(.34,.8,.3,1),top .85s cubic-bezier(.34,.8,.3,1),
    opacity .5s,border-color .5s,color .5s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pill i{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--ink3);flex:none;transition:.5s}
.pill.in{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
.pill.in i{background:var(--blue)}
.pill.out{border-color:var(--ochre2);color:var(--ochre);background:var(--ochre-wash)}
.pill.out i{background:var(--ochre2)}
.pill.ghost{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.toggle{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:22px}
.toggle button{padding:14px 16px;text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);
  transition:.18s;display:block}
.toggle button:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.toggle .yr{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.11em;color:var(--ink3);
  display:block;margin-bottom:3px}
.toggle .nm{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.2}
.toggle button.on{background:var(--blue)}
.toggle button.on .yr{color:var(--blue-wash)}
.toggle button.on .nm{color:#fff}
.tally{display:flex;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);margin-bottom:18px}
.tally div{flex:1;padding:12px 14px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.tally div:last-child{border-right:0}
.tally .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:34px;line-height:1;font-weight:500;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.tally .k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink3);margin-top:5px}
.tally .in .v{color:var(--blue)} .tally .out .v{color:var(--ochre)}
#perCap{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2);min-height:88px}
#perCap b{color:var(--ink)}
#perCap.hot b{color:var(--ochre)}

/* 6 tracks */
.tracks{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:0;
  position:relative;padding-bottom:8px}
.yearaxis{position:relative;height:22px;margin-left:212px;margin-bottom:6px}
.yearaxis span{position:absolute;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);
  font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink3)}
.lane{display:grid;grid-template-columns:212px 1fr;gap:0;align-items:center;
  padding:15px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule2);transition:opacity .3s;cursor:pointer}
.lane:last-of-type{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.lane.dim{opacity:.24}
.lane .lname{font-size:17px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.15}
.lane .lbet{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.09em;text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink3);margin-top:4px}
.lane.sel .lname{color:var(--blue)}
.track{position:relative;height:52px}
.track .base{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:26px;height:1.5px;background:var(--rule)}
.track .mk{position:absolute;top:26px;width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--blue);
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:2px solid var(--stock);z-index:3;transition:.3s}
.track .mk.acc{background:var(--ochre)}
.track .mk.hollow{background:var(--stock);border:2px solid var(--ochre2)}
.mklab{position:absolute;transform:translateX(-50%);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;
  letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s;
  z-index:4;text-align:center;line-height:1.35}
.mklab.up{top:-4px} .mklab.dn{top:40px}
.lane.sel .mklab{opacity:1}
.slid{position:absolute;top:26px;height:1.5px;background:var(--ochre2);transform:translateY(-50%);
  z-index:2}
.slid::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-1px;top:-3.5px;width:0;height:0;
  border-left:7px solid var(--ochre2);border-top:4px solid transparent;border-bottom:4px solid transparent}
.summary{position:absolute;right:0;top:26px;transform:translateY(-50%);
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink3);
  background:var(--stock);padding-left:10px;transition:opacity .3s}
.lane.sel .summary{opacity:0}
#trackCap{margin-top:18px;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--ink2);min-height:48px;
  max-width:88ch;padding-left:14px;border-left:2px solid var(--rule)}
#trackCap b{color:var(--ink)}
#trackCap.hot{border-left-color:var(--ochre2)}
#trackCap.hot b{color:var(--ochre)}

/* 4 autonomy */
.auto{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 336px;gap:40px;flex:1}
.acols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px;align-items:end}
.acol{border-top:2px solid var(--rule);padding-top:0;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end;height:340px}
.acol .stack{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap-reverse;gap:5px;align-content:flex-end;padding:12px 10px;
  background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule2);border-bottom:0;min-height:44px;
  transition:.2s}
.acol.on .stack{background:var(--blue-wash);border-color:var(--blue2)}
.acol .cell{width:15px;height:15px;border-radius:2px;transition:.2s}
.cell.t-rm{background:var(--blue)} .cell.t-af{background:var(--teal)} .cell.t-cx{background:var(--plum)}
.acol .foot{border-top:2px solid var(--ink3);padding:12px 10px 0;transition:.2s}
.acol.on .foot{border-top-color:var(--blue)}
.acol .lv{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink3);font-weight:600}
.acol.on .lv{color:var(--blue)}
.acol .nm{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px;line-height:1.2}
.acol .ct{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;font-weight:500;line-height:1;margin-top:8px;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.acol.on .ct{color:var(--blue)}
.acol .ds{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:6px;min-height:46px}
.legend{display:flex;gap:18px;margin-top:16px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;
  letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3)}
.legend span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
.legend i{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:2px;display:block}
.panel{border-left:1px solid var(--rule);padding-left:30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.panel h4{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.015em;
  margin-bottom:5px}
.panel .pd{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2);margin-bottom:16px}
.panel .pd b{color:var(--ink)}
.uclist{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1}
.uc{display:grid;grid-template-columns:16px 1fr;gap:10px;font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.35;
  animation:pop .28s both}
.uc i{width:9px;height:9px;border-radius:2px;margin-top:4px}
.uc .cd{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--ink3);display:block;margin-top:1px}


/* ── drawing system: blueprint plates (from the NotebookLM deck's look) rebuilt in the HKUST palette.
   One bold device: the glowing ochre path. Everything else is thin ink line on grid paper. ── */
.plate{position:relative;background-color:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--rule);
  background-image:linear-gradient(var(--rule2) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rule2) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:24px 24px;background-position:-1px -1px}
.plate::before,.plate::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;border-color:var(--ink3);border-style:solid;pointer-events:none}
.plate::before{left:8px;top:8px;border-width:1px 0 0 1px}
.plate::after{right:8px;bottom:8px;border-width:0 1px 1px 0}
.plate .figno{position:absolute;right:28px;top:10px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase}
.plate svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.sv .ln{fill:none;stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:1.6;stroke-linejoin:round;stroke-linecap:round}
.sv .lt{stroke-width:1}
.sv .lk{stroke-width:2.4}
.sv .ds{stroke-dasharray:4 5}
.sv .fa{fill:var(--raise)} .sv .fb{fill:var(--blue-wash)} .sv .fp{fill:var(--stock)} .sv .fo{fill:var(--ochre-wash)}
.sv .fn{fill:var(--blue)} .sv .fk{fill:var(--ochre2)} .sv .fi{fill:var(--ink2)} .sv .fr{fill:var(--rule)}
.sv .bl{stroke:var(--blue)} .sv .ac{stroke:var(--ochre2)} .sv .ru{stroke:var(--rule)}
.sv .glow{fill:none;stroke:var(--ochre2);stroke-width:3.4;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 5px var(--ochre2))}
.sv text{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;fill:var(--ink2);letter-spacing:.08em}
.sv .tl{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--ink);letter-spacing:0}
.sv .tb{fill:var(--blue)} .sv .to{fill:var(--ochre)} .sv .t3{fill:var(--ink3)}
.sv .ty{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:42px;fill:var(--ink);letter-spacing:-.02em;font-weight:500}
.sv .tv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:22px;fill:var(--ink);letter-spacing:0}
.sv [data-tab]{cursor:pointer}
.sv [data-tab]:focus-visible{outline:none}
.sv [data-tab]:focus-visible .hit{stroke:var(--blue);stroke-width:2}
.draw{stroke-dasharray:1;stroke-dashoffset:1}
.slide.on .draw{animation:dash 1.8s .35s cubic-bezier(.4,.1,.2,1) forwards}
@keyframes dash{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.draw{stroke-dashoffset:0}}

/* timeline */
.era-g .frame{fill:var(--raise);stroke:var(--ink3);stroke-width:1.4;transition:.25s}
.era-g.on .frame{fill:var(--blue-wash);stroke:var(--blue)}
.era-g.now .frame{stroke:var(--ochre2);stroke-width:2.6;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 7px var(--ochre2))}
.era-g.now.on .frame{fill:var(--ochre-wash)}
.eraline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise)}
.eraline>div{padding:12px 16px}
.eraline>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.eraline .t{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;color:var(--ochre);margin-bottom:4px}
.eraline>div+div .t{color:var(--blue)}
.eraline p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.eraline p b{color:var(--ink)}
.quote{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;line-height:1.28;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.quote cite{display:block;font-family:var(--sans);font-style:normal;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:8px}
.bigfig{border:1.5px solid var(--ochre2);background:var(--raise);padding:14px 18px;position:relative}
.bigfig::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-1.5px;top:-1.5px;width:14px;height:14px;background:var(--ochre2);clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,0 100%)}
.bigfig .v{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:44px;line-height:1;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.bigfig p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:6px}
.bigfig .s{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:6px}

/* split syntax / imagination */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;flex:1;min-height:0;margin:0 -76px -50px}
.split>div{padding:20px 40px 40px 76px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-width:0}
.split>div+div{padding:20px 76px 40px 40px;background:var(--raise);border-left:1px solid var(--rule)}
.split .eratitle{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:38px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;margin-bottom:14px}
.split .code{background:transparent;border:0;padding:0;font-size:13.5px}
.app .bar2{transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(.05);transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
.app.built .bar2{transform:scaleY(1)}
.app .late{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s .8s}
.app.built .late{opacity:1}

/* hk tiles */
.tiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(10,1fr);gap:6px;padding:22px 22px 16px}
.tiles i{aspect-ratio:1;background:var(--blue2);transition:background .35s,box-shadow .35s}
.tiles i.lost{background:transparent;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1.5px var(--ochre2)}
.tilecap{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink2);text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 22px 18px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}

/* ladder states */
.lad .ghost{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s}
.lad.oct .ghost{opacity:1}
.lad .newrung{transition:.5s}
.lad.oct .newrung{fill:var(--ochre2);stroke:var(--ochre2)}
.lad .newlab{opacity:0;transition:opacity .5s .2s}
.lad.oct .newlab{opacity:1}
.mono-quote{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:21px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink)}

/* pyramid */
.pyr rect{transition:fill .5s,stroke .5s,opacity .5s}
.pyr .tile{fill:var(--blue2);stroke:var(--blue2)}
.pyr .tile.cut{fill:transparent;stroke:var(--ochre2);stroke-dasharray:3 3}

/* hub (new staff) */
.hub .role .hit{fill:transparent;stroke:transparent}
.hub .role.on .hit{fill:var(--blue-wash);stroke:var(--blue)}
.hub .you.on .hit{fill:var(--ochre-wash);stroke:var(--ochre2)}
.rolepanel{min-height:70px}

/* checklist */
.checks{display:flex;flex-direction:column;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.chk{text-align:left;display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 1fr;gap:12px;padding:13px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.chk .bx{width:22px;height:22px;border:1.5px solid var(--ink3);font-family:var(--mono);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:13px;color:transparent;margin-top:2px}
.chk.done .bx{background:var(--blue);border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--onaccent)}
.chk h4{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:17px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.01em}
.chk p{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:3px}

/* pipeline */
.pipe .lock .hit{fill:var(--ochre-wash);stroke:var(--ochre2);stroke-width:1.8;transition:.2s}
.pipe .lock.on .hit{fill:var(--ochre2)}
.pipe .lock.on .key{fill:var(--onaccent)}
.pipe .key{fill:var(--ochre)}
.shout{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:44px;line-height:1.1;color:var(--ochre);font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.02em}

/* polymath */
.poly circle{fill:var(--raise);stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:1.4}
.poly circle.big{fill:var(--ink2)}
.poly line{stroke:var(--ink3);stroke-width:1}

/* moat */
.moat .ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--blue2);stroke-width:14;opacity:.35}
.moat .ic.on .hit{fill:var(--ochre-wash);stroke:var(--ochre2)}

/* mirror */
.mirror .brain{transition:filter .9s,opacity .9s}
.mirror.blur .brain{filter:url(#fog);opacity:.55}

/* distance (part 2 opener) */
.dim text{font-size:12px}

/* video slides */
.vslide .vid{max-height:520px}
.vtitle{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:20px;margin-bottom:12px}
.watchfor{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise)}
.watchfor>div{padding:16px 18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.watchfor>div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.watchfor svg{width:54px;height:54px}
.watchfor h4{font-size:16px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25}
.watchfor p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.45;color:var(--ink2)}
.watchfor .ts{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--ochre);letter-spacing:.06em}
.whos{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:8px}
.whos div{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:10px 12px;background:var(--raise)}
.whos b{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;color:var(--blue);display:block}
.whos span{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--ink2)}

/* sandbox hub */
.reg circle{fill:var(--raise);stroke:var(--blue);stroke-width:1.6}
.reg text{fill:var(--blue);font-weight:600}

/* 80/20 bar */
.split8020{display:grid;grid-template-columns:4fr 1fr;height:58px;border:1px solid var(--rule)}
.split8020 div{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600}
.split8020 div:first-child{background:var(--blue-wash);color:var(--blue)}
.split8020 div:last-child{background:var(--ochre2);color:var(--onaccent);justify-content:center}

/* network */
.net .node circle{fill:var(--raise);stroke:var(--ink2);stroke-width:1.5}
.net .node text{font-size:11px}
.net .node.you circle{fill:var(--ochre2);stroke:var(--ochre2)}

/* ── live layer ── */
#livePill{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;padding:4px 9px;border:1px solid var(--rule);color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
#livePill.live{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal)}
#livePill.live::before{content:"";display:inline-block;width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal);margin-right:6px;animation:pulse 1.8s infinite}
#livePill.reh{border-color:var(--ochre2);color:var(--ochre)}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.25}}
#qrOverlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:40;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--paper) 92%,transparent);display:grid;place-items:center;cursor:pointer}
#qrOverlay .qrbox{display:flex;gap:44px;align-items:center;background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:36px 44px;box-shadow:0 20px 60px var(--shadow)}
#qrBig{background:#fff;padding:12px}
#qrOverlay .qk{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:44px;line-height:1}
#qrOverlay .qu{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:22px;color:var(--blue);margin-top:14px}
#qrOverlay .qr2{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;color:var(--ink2);margin-top:8px}
#qrOverlay .qn{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;color:var(--ochre);margin-top:22px}
#livePanel{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:var(--chromeH);width:340px;background:var(--raise);border-right:1px solid var(--rule);padding:24px;z-index:19;
  transform:translateX(-100%);transition:transform .3s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;overflow-y:auto}
#livePanel.open{transform:none}
#livePanel h5{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--blue)}
#livePanel p,#livePanel label{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--ink2)}
#livePanel b{color:var(--ink)}
#livePanel input[type=password]{padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;width:100%}
.lp-chk{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.lp-lab{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.lp-gem,.lp-url{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px!important;word-break:break-all}
#lpRooms{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);padding:14px 0}
#lpRooms[hidden]{display:none}
.lp-new{display:flex;gap:8px}
#livePanel input[type=text]{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;font-family:var(--mono)}
.lp-hint,.lp-msg{font-size:12px!important;color:var(--ink3)!important}
.lp-msg:empty{display:none}
.lp-rh{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-top:4px}
.lp-link{background:none;border:0;padding:0;font:inherit;font-size:12px;color:var(--blue);cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px}
.lp-link.lr-del{color:var(--ochre2)}
#lpList{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.lp-room{border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:10px 12px}
.lp-room.here{border-color:var(--blue)}
.lr-top{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lr-name{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:13px}
.lr-tag{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;border:1px solid var(--rule);padding:1px 6px;color:var(--ink3)}
.lr-tag.on{border-color:var(--blue);color:var(--blue)}
#livePanel .lr-n{font-size:12px;margin-top:2px}
.lr-act{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:4px}

/* poll widget */
.poll{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.pq-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:24px;align-items:start}
.pq{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:30px;line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.012em;text-wrap:balance}
.pq-join{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}
.pq-join p{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--ink2)}
.pq-join b{color:var(--ochre);font-size:11px}
.qrmini{background:#fff;padding:5px;width:106px;height:106px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.qrmini img,.qrmini canvas,.qr-slot img,.qr-slot canvas{display:block;max-width:100%}
.qr-slot{background:#fff;padding:8px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center}
.pbars{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.pbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(150px,auto) 1fr 64px;gap:16px;align-items:center}
.pbar .pl{font-size:17px;font-weight:500}
.pbar .pt{height:34px;background:var(--rule2);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pbar .pt i{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;background:var(--blue2);transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.3,1)}
.pbar.top .pt i{background:var(--blue)}
.pbar.right .pt i{background:var(--teal)}
.pbar.right .pl::after{content:"  ✓";color:var(--teal)}
.pbar .pv{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:24px;text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.pfoot{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.ptot{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase}
.pact{display:flex;gap:8px}
.poll.compact .pq{font-size:22px}
.poll.compact .pbar .pt{height:24px}
.poll.compact .pbar .pl{font-size:14px}
.poll.compact .pbar .pv{font-size:18px}
.poll.compact .qrmini{width:84px;height:84px}

/* wall of worries */
.wall-live{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 300px;gap:22px;flex:1;min-height:0}
.wall-live .wv{position:relative}
.wall-live svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.wall-live svg .lt{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;fill:var(--ink)}
.wall-live svg .ln{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;fill:var(--ink3);letter-spacing:.06em}
.wall-empty{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:26px;color:var(--ink3)}
.wall-side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px}
.wcount{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--raise)}
.wcount div{padding:10px 12px}
.wcount div+div{border-left:1px solid var(--rule2)}

  transform:scale(.2);opacity:0;transform-origin:var(--ox,50%) var(--oy,50%);transition:transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1),opacity .3s}

/* YouTube clips */
.yt{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 250px;gap:26px;flex:1;min-height:0;align-items:start}

/* photo plates (MSBA pictures) */

.tipwide{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:22px;flex:1;min-height:0;justify-content:center}

/* Part 4 · advice: the tip pops up over its skill slide */
.adv-btn{margin-left:14px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;
  border:1px solid var(--ochre2);background:var(--ochre-wash);color:var(--ochre);padding:5px 11px;cursor:pointer}
.advice{position:absolute;left:34px;right:34px;top:54px;bottom:30px;z-index:6;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--rule);
  box-shadow:0 34px 90px -24px var(--shadow);padding:16px 40px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  opacity:0;transform:scale(.9) translateY(18px);transform-origin:100% 0;transition:opacity .3s,transform .45s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1);pointer-events:none}

  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;flex:none}

/* chapters on the long clip */

/* clicker: hide the cursor when the mouse rests; step dots in the bar */

/* wall v2: blocks */
.wall-live .wv{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;min-height:0;min-width:0}
.wtm{position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0}
.wb{position:absolute;box-sizing:border-box;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;overflow:hidden;
  background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 13%,var(--raise));border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 45%,transparent);
  transition:left .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1),top .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1),width .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1),height .9s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.25,1),opacity .5s,transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2)}
.wb.top{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 22%,var(--raise));border-color:var(--c)}
.wb-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.wb-r{font-weight:600;color:var(--c)}
.wb-n i{font-style:normal;color:var(--ink3);text-transform:uppercase;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em}
.wb-t{font-family:var(--serif);font-weight:500;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.01em;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
.wb-q{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;min-height:0;overflow:hidden}
.wb-q p{font-family:var(--serif);font-style:italic;color:var(--ink2);line-height:1.3;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;overflow:hidden}
.wb-q p:first-child{color:var(--ink)}
.wb-q p.swap{animation:qswap .6s both}
@keyframes qswap{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px)}}
.wb.xl .wb-t{font-size:34px}.wb.xl .wb-q p{font-size:17px}
.wb.lg .wb-t{font-size:25px}.wb.lg .wb-q p{font-size:15px}
.wb.md .wb-t{font-size:19px}.wb.md .wb-q p{font-size:13px;-webkit-line-clamp:1}
.wb.sm{padding:8px 10px}.wb.sm .wb-t{font-size:14.5px}.wb.sm .wb-q{display:none}.wb.sm .wb-n i{display:none}
.wb.pulse{animation:wbpulse 1s ease-out}
@keyframes wbpulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 55%,transparent)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px transparent}}
.winc-wrap{flex:none;min-width:0;height:40px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-top:1px dashed var(--rule);padding-top:8px;overflow:hidden}
.winc-k{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);flex:none}
.winc{display:flex;gap:8px;overflow:hidden;flex:1;min-width:0}
.wchip{flex:none;max-width:260px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;font-size:13px;padding:5px 10px;background:var(--raise);border:1px solid var(--rule);
  animation:chipin .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.3,1.2) both;transition:transform .85s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.3,1),opacity .85s ease-in}
.wchip.fly{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 25%,var(--raise));border-color:var(--c)}
@keyframes chipin{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.9)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wb,.wchip{transition:none;animation:none}}
.wb.md .mt,.wb.sm .mt{display:none}
.photo.fit img.bg{position:absolute;inset:0;filter:blur(26px) brightness(.75);transform:scale(1.2)}
.photo.fit img.fg{position:relative;object-fit:contain}

/* review edition: nothing live, nothing private */
#livePanel,#qrOverlay,#notes,#btnNotes,#livePill,.psync,.pq-join,.qr-slot,.wall-regroup,#zoom .draft{display:none!important}

<section data-id="hk" data-title="Hong Kong&#x27;s 60%" class="slide" data-part="1">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 1 · The missing rung</span><span class="line"></span><span class="ask">Guess the number</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 400px;gap:46px">
      <div>
        <div class="partno" style="font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ochre);font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px">Part 1 of 4</div>
        <h1 style="font-size:46px;max-width:22ch">Since 2022, how many Hong Kong graduate jobs disappeared?</h1>
        <p class="sub">Full-time vacancies suitable for university graduates, 2022 against 2025. Shout a number.</p>
        <div class="poll compact noq" data-poll="guess" data-q="Since 2022, how many Hong Kong graduate jobs disappeared?" data-opts="10%|30%|60%|90%" data-sim="2,5,3,1" style="margin-top:18px"></div>
        <div class="reveal" style="margin-top:14px"><button class="btn go" id="guessGo">Reveal</button>
          <div class="answer" id="guessAns" hidden><div class="v">About 60%.</div>
            <p>Roughly <b>80,000</b> in 2022, about <b>31,000</b> in 2025. And unemployment for 20–29s is <b>6.8%</b>, almost double the 3.7% for everyone. <span class="src" style="display:block;margin-top:6px">HKUST Business School, Aug 2026 · C&amp;SD via SCMP</span></p></div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="plate"><span class="figno">Fig. 1.1</span>
        <div class="tiles" id="tiles"></div>
        <div class="tilecap"><span>1 square = 1,000 vacancies</span><span id="tilecount">2022 · 80,000</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="slide" data-part="1">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 1 · The missing rung</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 1.2 · click an era</span></div>
  <div class="body" data-tabs>
    <h2 style="margin-bottom:12px">Every wave of computing moved the first rung.</h2>
    <div class="plate"><span class="figno">Fig. 1.2</span>
      <svg class="sv" viewBox="0 0 1128 290" role="img" aria-label="Timeline: 1980s mainframe, 1990s PC and internet, 2010s mobile and cloud, 2026 agentic AI">

        <path class="glow draw" pathLength="1" d="M1082,165 H1118"/>
        <path class="ln ac" d="M1102,152 L1120,165 L1102,178"/>
        <path class="ln lt ac" d="M1084,150 L1118,128 M1084,180 L1118,202 M1088,158 L1124,146 M1088,172 L1124,184"/>
        <g class="era-g" data-tab="a" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="1980s mainframe" transform="translate(141,165)">
          <polygon class="frame hit" points="-95,-63 -80,-78 80,-78 95,-63 95,63 80,78 -80,78 -95,63"/>
          <rect class="ln fa" x="-30" y="-55" width="60" height="110"/><path class="ln lt" d="M30,-55 L42,-47 V63 L30,55"/>
          <rect class="ln lt" x="-22" y="-45" width="44" height="16"/><path class="ln lt" d="M-22,-20H22M-22,-12H22M-22,-4H22"/>
          <rect class="ln lt" x="-22" y="8" width="18" height="38"/><rect class="fk" x="6" y="10" width="14" height="8"/>
          <text class="ty" x="0" y="-100" text-anchor="middle">1980s</text><text x="0" y="104" text-anchor="middle">MAINFRAME</text>

<section data-id="syntax" data-title="Imagination is the new syntax" class="slide" data-part="1">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 1 · The missing rung</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 1.3</span></div>
  <div class="body" style="padding-top:12px">
    <h1 style="font-size:52px;max-width:none">Imagination is the new syntax.</h1>
    <p class="sub" style="margin:4px 0 16px;font-size:20px">The era of vibe coding.</p>
    <div class="split">
      <div>
        <div class="eratitle">2015: Syntax</div>
<div class="code"><span class="k">#include</span> &lt;vector&gt;
<span class="k">class</span> StudyTracker {
  std::vector&lt;<span class="k">int</span>&gt; minutes;
<span class="k">public</span>:
  <span class="k">void</span> add(<span class="k">int</span> m) { minutes.push_back(m); }
  <span class="k">double</span> average() {
    <span class="c">// loops, types, memory, edge cases…</span>
  }
};
<span class="k">int</span> main() {
  StudyTracker t;
  <span class="c">// …and then build a UI. Weeks of work.</span>
}</div>
        <p class="sub" style="font-size:14.5px;margin-top:auto">Years of practice first. Most business students never got here, so they <b>wrote requirements and waited for IT.</b></p>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="eratitle" style="color:var(--blue)">2026: Imagination</div>
        <p class="prompt me" style="font-size:17px;max-width:none;margin:0 0 14px">Build me a web app that tracks my study hours per course, shows the weeks I fall behind, and nags me on Sunday nights.</p>

            <g transform="translate(0,180)">
              <rect class="bar2 fn" x="30" y="-62" width="26" height="62"/><rect class="bar2 fn" x="70" y="-80" width="26" height="80"/>
              <rect class="bar2 fk" x="110" y="-34" width="26" height="34"/><rect class="bar2 fn" x="150" y="-90" width="26" height="90"/>
              <rect class="bar2 fk" x="190" y="-22" width="26" height="22"/><rect class="bar2 fn" x="230" y="-76" width="26" height="76"/>

            </g>

              <text class="to" x="330" y="112" style="font-size:9.5px">2 DAYS BEHIND</text><text class="tl" x="330" y="132" style="font-size:12px">Accounting</text><text class="tl" x="330" y="150" style="font-size:12px">Statistics</text></g>

</section>

<section class="slide" data-part="1">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 1 · The missing rung</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 1.6 · interactive</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="kicker o">What I said in January · click each to see the October 2026 data</div>
    <h2 style="margin-bottom:14px">Four things I'd say differently now.</h2>
    <div class="flips">
      <button class="flip" data-reveal><span class="when">January 2026</span><span class="q">"The junior analyst role is being deleted."</span>
        <span class="a"><b>Hiring, not firing.</b> Young workers in AI-exposed jobs aren't being laid off; fewer are being hired. The door is narrower, not locked. <i>Stanford; US Census.</i></span></button>
      <button class="flip" data-reveal><span class="when">January 2026</span><span class="q">"Entry-level jobs are disappearing."</span>
        <span class="a"><b>The rung moved up.</b> AI-exposed entry jobs grew 35% since 2019 while other entry jobs fell 10%, but they are <b>7×</b> more likely to ask for senior-level skills. <i>PwC AI Jobs Barometer, Jun 2026.</i></span></button>
      <button class="flip" data-reveal><span class="when">January 2026</span><span class="q">"AI is why graduates can't find jobs."</span>
        <span class="a"><b>Partly, and disputed.</b> US unemployment for new graduates was 7.3% in summer 2026, inside its 2022–26 range. In HK, the survey lead blames the economy more than AI. <i>CESifo WP 12994; HKUST.</i></span></button>
      <button class="flip" data-reveal><span class="when">January 2026</span><span class="q">"Learn AI or become obsolete."</span>
        <span class="a"><b>Learn AI and get paid for it.</b> Jobs needing AI skills pay a <b>62%</b> premium, up from 57% a year ago. AI-skill postings grew 69% against 9% overall. <i>PwC, Jun 2026.</i></span></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section data-skip class="slide" data-part="1">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 1 · The missing rung</span><span class="line"></span><span class="ask">Vote</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="kicker">You decide</div>
    <h2>Is AI the main reason graduate jobs fell?</h2>
    <div class="poll compact noq" data-poll="aireason" data-q="Is AI the main reason graduate jobs fell?" data-opts="Yes, mainly AI|Partly|No, it's the economy" data-sim="3,6,3" style="margin-top:12px"></div>
    <div style="margin-top:18px"><button class="btn go" data-show="#evid">Show the evidence</button></div>
    <div id="evid" hidden class="row" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:16px;align-items:stretch">
      <div class="card"><div class="t">For AI</div><p>Stanford tested the interest-rate explanation. AI-exposed jobs were <b>less</b> sensitive to rates, yet young workers there fell most. The gap is still widening.</p></div>
      <div class="card warm"><div class="t">Against</div><p>US graduate unemployment in 2026 is within its normal range, and the AI link isn't statistically significant. HK lost back-office work to Shanghai and Singapore.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

    <h1 style="font-size:54px">Why a bank can't just "use ChatGPT"</h1>
    <div class="plate" style="margin-top:16px"><span class="figno">Fig. 2.1</span>

        <g class="ln fa"><rect x="895" y="118" width="16" height="74"/><rect x="935" y="118" width="16" height="74"/><rect x="989" y="118" width="16" height="74"/><rect x="1029" y="118" width="16" height="74"/></g>

      <span class="src" style="margin-right:6px">Five questions a bank answers first:</span>
      <span class="btn" style="cursor:default">Which tool?</span><span class="btn" style="cursor:default">Which data?</span><span class="btn" style="cursor:default">Who checks it?</span><span class="btn" style="cursor:default">Who signs it?</span><span class="btn" style="cursor:default">Can we prove it a year later?</span>

<section class="slide" data-part="2">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 2 · Inside a bank</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 2.2 · interactive</span></div>
  <div class="body" data-tabs>
    <div class="kicker">Six words you'll hear in every AI meeting · click each</div>
    <div class="explore" style="margin-top:6px">
      <div class="tabs col">
        <button class="btn" data-tab="a">Model (LLM) <small>the engine</small></button>
        <button class="btn" data-tab="b">Prompt <small>the instruction</small></button>
        <button class="btn" data-tab="c">Context <small>what it can see</small></button>
        <button class="btn" data-tab="d">Hallucination <small>the risk</small></button>
        <button class="btn" data-tab="e">Grounding <small>the fix</small></button>
        <button class="btn" data-tab="f">Agent <small>the doer</small></button>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="a"><div class="word">Model</div><p class="plain">A large language model is a prediction engine trained on huge amounts of text. It writes the most likely next words, very well.</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">The engine inside ChatGPT, Gemini or Claude.</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">Banks pick <b>approved</b> models, often hosted privately, so client data never trains someone else's model.</span></div></div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="b" hidden><div class="word">Prompt</div><p class="plain">The instruction you give the model. A clear goal, context, format and examples get better answers.</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">"Summarise this article in five bullet points for a busy manager."</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">Citi's training teaches <b>"great prompting versus basic prompting"</b>. Experts finish in under 10 minutes, beginners in about 30.</span></div></div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="c" hidden><div class="word">Context</div><p class="plain">Everything the model can see when it answers: your prompt, attached files, the chat so far. It knows nothing else about your situation.</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">Uploading your lecture notes so it answers about <b>your</b> course.</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">Whatever you put in the context leaves your hands. That's why <b>data classification</b> rules exist.</span></div></div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="d" hidden><div class="word">Hallucination</div><p class="plain">When the model states something false, confidently. It isn't lying. It's predicting plausible words with no source behind them.</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">A made-up citation in your essay that looks perfectly real.</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">A wrong number in a client report is a <b>conduct issue</b>. The HKMA's own sandbox report calls hallucination a key concern.</span></div></div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="e" hidden><div class="word">Grounding</div><p class="plain">Making the model answer only from documents you trust, and show which line each answer came from. Often called RAG (retrieval-augmented generation).</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">"Answer only from this PDF, and quote the page."</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">The standard pattern: <b>approved content only, every answer cited</b>.</span></div></div>
        <div class="def" data-panel="f" hidden><div class="word">Agent</div><p class="plain">A model that can plan steps, use tools (search, files, email, code) and keep going until a goal is done.</p>
          <div class="kv"><span class="k">Everyday</span><span class="v">"Find three flights under HK$3,000 and put them in a table." It searches, compares and builds the table.</span><span class="k">In a bank</span><span class="v">The exciting part and the scary part. <b>Who approved what the agent did?</b></span></div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="slide" data-part="2">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 2 · Before the video</span><span class="line"></span><span>9 minutes</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="vtitle"><h2 style="font-size:36px;max-width:none">Up next: how Hong Kong governs AI in finance</h2><span class="time">9 minutes in 4 short clips · made by agents in my cloned voice</span></div>
    <div class="watchfor">
      <div><svg class="sv" viewBox="0 0 54 54"><rect class="ln lt ds" x="6" y="8" width="30" height="38"/><path class="ln lt" d="M12,18H30M12,26H30M12,34H24"/><circle class="fk" cx="46" cy="40" r="5"/></svg>
        <h4>The rulebook's edge</h4><p>What counts as a "model" a bank must check, and what got left outside in April 2026.</p></div>
      <div><svg class="sv" viewBox="0 0 54 54"><path class="ln lt" d="M4,12H50M4,27H50M4,42H50"/><circle class="fn" cx="18" cy="12" r="3.5"/><circle class="fn" cx="16" cy="27" r="3.5"/><path class="ln ac lt" d="M20,27H34"/><circle class="fk" cx="36" cy="27" r="3.5"/><g class="fn"><circle cx="10" cy="42" r="3"/><circle cx="18" cy="42" r="3"/><circle cx="26" cy="42" r="3"/><circle cx="34" cy="42" r="3"/><circle cx="42" cy="42" r="3"/></g></svg>
        <h4>Three bets</h4><p>The US, the EU and Hong Kong each govern AI a different way. Look at the shapes.</p></div>
      <div><svg class="sv" viewBox="0 0 54 54"><rect class="ln fb" x="15" y="15" width="24" height="24"/><g class="ln fa"><circle cx="27" cy="6" r="4"/><circle cx="27" cy="48" r="4"/><circle cx="6" cy="27" r="4"/><circle cx="48" cy="27" r="4"/></g><path class="ln lt" d="M27,10V15M27,39V44M10,27H15M39,27H44"/></svg>
        <h4>Sandbox++</h4><p>36 AI pilots tested under four regulators at once. How much is the AI allowed to decide?</p></div>
      <div><svg class="sv" viewBox="0 0 54 54"><rect class="ln ac fo" x="3" y="20" width="16" height="14" rx="7"/><rect class="ln ac fo" x="19" y="20" width="16" height="14" rx="7"/><rect class="ln ac fo" x="35" y="20" width="16" height="14" rx="7"/></svg>
        <h4>Know your agent</h4><p>KYC checks a customer. When software pays on your behalf, who checks the software?</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="kicker" style="margin-top:20px">The four referees you'll hear about</div>
    <div class="whos"><div><b>HKMA</b><span>Banks</span></div><div><b>SFC</b><span>Securities &amp; investments</span></div><div><b>IA</b><span>Insurance</span></div><div><b>MPFA</b><span>Pensions (MPF)</span></div></div>
    <p class="sub" style="margin-top:14px"><b>A sandbox</b> is a practice match where the referees watch you play before the real game. It isn't permission to launch.</p>
  </div>
</section>
