<section class="slide" data-part="2">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 2 · Check-in</span><span class="line"></span><span class="ask">Vote, then clip 2</span></div>
  <div class="body" style="justify-content:center">
    <p class="sub" style="margin:0 0 14px">A US bank uses generative AI to draft the credit memo for a loan. In April 2026 the regulators rewrote the model rulebook.</p>
    <div class="poll" data-poll="rules" data-q="Is the AI drafting the credit memo governed by the new rules?" data-opts="Yes, the new rules cover it|No, the bank must write its own|No, nobody governs it" data-correct="1" data-answer="#ansRules" data-sim="6,5,2"></div>
    <div class="slab warm" id="ansRules" hidden style="margin-top:18px"><div class="t">The answer · the rulebook shrank</div><p>The new rules <b>left generative AI out on purpose</b>. A simple scoring model for the same loan is inside; the AI writing the memo is outside. The bank has to build its own rules, with no template. That's why approvals take so long. Clip 2 shows what else fell out.</p></div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="slide" data-part="2">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 2 · Before the video</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 2.3 · interactive</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="q3">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Governance in three questions · click each</div>
        <h2 style="font-size:32px;max-width:24ch">Governance isn't a document. It's three questions, answered by three different people.</h2>
        <div class="qs" id="qs"></div>
      </div>
      <div>
        <div class="owner" id="qOwner">Who answers it</div>
        <div class="stack3">
          <div class="tier" id="t0"><div class="tn">The regulator</div><div class="tr" id="r0">Draws the outer line.</div></div>
          <div class="tier" id="t1"><div class="tn">The bank</div><div class="tr" id="r1">Sets policy inside it.</div></div>
          <div class="tier" id="t2"><div class="tn">The business control team</div><div class="tr" id="r2">Sets limits for each system.</div></div>
        </div>
        <p class="moved" id="qMoved"></p>
        <div class="gs" id="qGs" hidden>
          <div class="gate"><div class="hd">A gate</div><p><b>A teacher marks every exam</b> before results go out. Catches everything, slow at scale. Hong Kong's SFC asks for this.</p></div>
          <div class="sensor"><div class="hd">A sensor</div><p><b>CCTV that watches everything</b> and flags trouble afterwards. Scales well, catches late. Where US guidance is heading.</p></div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="slide" data-part="2">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 2 · Debrief</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 2.4 · interactive</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="kicker">Debrief 1 · inside or outside the rulebook? Vote, then click 2026</div>
    <h2 style="max-width:30ch;font-size:32px">The rulebook shrank. The AI didn't.</h2>
    <div class="perwrap" style="margin-top:6px">
      <div class="field" id="field"><div class="perim" id="perim"><span class="plab" id="perimLab">Model risk rulebook</span></div></div>

      <button class="qc d1" data-reveal><span class="qt">Summarise my own meeting notes into actions</span><span class="tagd">Door one</span><span class="qa">Your output, your check. If it's wrong, you notice and fix it.</span></button>
      <button class="qc d2" data-reveal><span class="qt">A chatbot that answers customers' questions about fees</span><span class="tagd">Door two</span><span class="qa">It speaks to customers. A wrong answer is a conduct issue, so it needs a second model checking every reply.</span></button>
      <button class="qc d1" data-reveal><span class="qt">Translate an internal memo into Chinese for my team</span><span class="tagd">Door one</span><span class="qa">Internal, low stakes, and a human reads it before it goes anywhere.</span></button>
      <button class="qc d2" data-reveal><span class="qt">Decide whether to approve a small-business loan</span><span class="tagd">Door two</span><span class="qa">A credit decision. Model risk, fairness and a named approver. The AI can assemble the evidence; a person decides.</span></button>
      <button class="qc d2" data-reveal><span class="qt">Draft the suspicious-transaction reports for flagged accounts</span><span class="tagd">Door two</span><span class="qa">Financial crime. HKMA sandbox banks cut drafting effort 30–80%, but humans review and file.</span></button>
      <button class="qc d2" data-reveal><span class="qt">The same dashboard tool, pointed at client data</span><span class="tagd">Trick · door two</span><span class="qa">On public data it's door one. <b>The moment it touches production data, it changes door.</b> Nothing else about it has to change.</span></button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="slide" data-part="3">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 3 · Agents at work</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 3.1 · interactive</span></div>
  <div class="body" data-tabs>
    <div class="kicker">Four building blocks · think of a new intern · click each</div>
    <div class="blocks tabs">
      <button class="blk" data-tab="a"><div class="bn">Block 1</div><h4>Prompt</h4><div class="an">Telling the intern once</div></button>
      <button class="blk" data-tab="b"><div class="bn">Block 2</div><h4>Skill</h4><div class="an">The written procedure</div></button>
      <button class="blk" data-tab="c"><div class="bn">Block 3</div><h4>Plugin</h4><div class="an">The team's starter kit</div></button>
      <button class="blk" data-tab="d"><div class="bn">Block 4</div><h4>Agent</h4><div class="an">The intern who gets it done</div></button>
    </div>
    <div class="blkgrow"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></div>
    <div class="blkbody" data-panel="a"><div class="card"><div class="t">What it is</div><p>An instruction you type into a chat. It works for that conversation, then it's gone. Next time you start again, and you'll phrase it differently.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="t">Example</div><p>"Turn these meeting notes into a list of actions with owners and dates."</p></div></div>
    <div class="blkbody" data-panel="b" hidden><div class="card"><div class="t">What it is</div><p>A saved file of instructions, and sometimes templates and scripts, that the AI loads when the task comes up. <b>Same steps, same checks, same format, every time.</b> You call it by name, like <span style="font-family:var(--mono)">/process-map</span>.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="t">Example</div><p>A process-map skill: "Turn minutes into a flowchart. Cite the source line for every step. Never invent a date. Flag contradictions, don't fix them."</p></div></div>
    <div class="blkbody" data-panel="c" hidden><div class="card"><div class="t">What it is</div><p>A package for a team: several skills plus <b>connections to the tools they need</b> (calendar, email, a database), and shortcut commands. Install once, the whole team works the same way.</p></div><div class="card"><div class="t">Example</div><p>A "finance controllers" plugin with skills for reconciliations, variance commentary and month-end checklists, connected to the reporting system.</p></div></div>
    <div class="blkbody" data-panel="d" hidden><div class="card"><div class="t">What it is</div><p>A model that <b>plans its own steps, uses tools and loops until the goal is met</b>. It picks which skills to use. It can work while you sleep.</p></div><div class="card warm"><div class="t">Example</div><p>"Every night, read the family chat, pull out tasks and dates, and give me a briefing at 7am." That's my CHO, coming up in ten minutes.</p></div></div>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="slide" data-part="3">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 3 · Agents at work</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 3.2</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="kicker">Why companies care</div>
    <h2 style="margin-bottom:16px">A prompt is personal. A skill is organisational.</h2>
    <div class="cmp">
      <div class="h"></div><div class="h b">A prompt in a chat</div><div class="h o">A skill</div>
      <div class="rk">Consistency</div><div>Different every time someone types it</div><div class="sk">Same steps and format, whoever runs it</div>
      <div class="rk">Rules</div><div>Only if the user remembers them</div><div class="sk">Guardrails written in, applied on every run</div>
      <div class="rk">Review</div><div>Lost in someone's chat history</div><div class="sk">A file that can be reviewed, versioned and approved</div>
      <div class="rk">Sharing</div><div>Copy-paste between colleagues</div><div class="sk">Installed for a whole team in one go</div>
      <div class="rk">Know-how</div><div>Stays in one person's head</div><div class="sk"><b>Written down so a machine can follow it and a new joiner can read it</b></div>
    </div>
    <p class="src" style="margin-top:14px">Back to Part 2: guardrails inside the skill are how a door-one tool earns trust</p>
  </div>
</section>
<section data-skip class="slide" data-part="3">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 3 · Inside a skill</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 3.3</span></div>
  <div class="body">
    <div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 380px;align-items:start;gap:34px">
      <div>
        <div class="kicker">Inside a real skill · SKILL.md, shortened</div>
<div class="code" style="font-size:12.5px"><span class="c">---</span>
<span class="k">name:</span> praxis-process-map
<span class="k">description:</span> Turn a messy human source (meeting minutes,
  a chat export, an email thread) into one editable HTML file
  with flow, Gantt, planner and action views. Every item cites
  its source line. Contradictions are surfaced, not resolved.
  <span class="s">No date is ever invented.</span>
<span class="c">---</span>
Messy human context in → editable artifact out →
the human keeps the decision → nothing leaves the machine.

<span class="s">Never write or regenerate the tool's HTML.</span> You produce a
JSON payload and inject it into a template that already works.

<span class="k">## Guardrails, these come first</span>
1. The human supplies the golden copy.
2. No fabricated data. Ever.
3. Challenge; never silently correct.  <span class="c">…</span></div>
        <p class="src" style="margin-top:10px">My own skill · 238 lines in full</p>
      </div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">My seven guardrails</div>
        <ul class="dots" style="margin-top:4px">
          <li><b>The human supplies the golden copy.</b></li>
          <li><b>No fabricated data.</b></li>
          <li><b>Challenge, never silently correct.</b></li>
          <li><b>Association, never cause.</b></li>
          <li><b>Every statement carries its source.</b></li>
          <li><b>Say what the output doesn't tell you.</b></li>
          <li><b>Only the tools the job needs.</b></li>
        </ul>
        <p style="margin-top:12px">They bind the tool, not the person. That's how a bank could trust it.</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

      <div class="card"><div class="t">1 · Who builds changes</div><p>Someone who can describe the outcome precisely can build the first version. <b>Imagination is the new syntax.</b></p></div>
      <div class="card"><div class="t">2 · Know-how becomes a file</div><p>A skill captures what only a few people know. <b>It must keep running, or it rots like an old wiki.</b></p></div>
      <div class="card warm"><div class="t">3 · Someone still signs</div><p>Building blurs. <b>Accountability hardens.</b> That's the human moat from Part 1.</p></div>
    </div>
    <div class="argue"><span class="ak">Discuss</span>
      <p>Agents cope well with old, messy bank systems. Will banks <b>finally clean up</b>, or <b>keep the mess longer</b>?</p>
      <p>If an agent wrote the code, <b>who is to blame</b> when it breaks?</p>
      <p>If your know-how lives in a skill file, <b>what's left that's only yours?</b></p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section data-id="market" data-title="The market lacks orchestrators" class="slide" data-part="4">
  <div class="rail"><span class="seg">Part 4 · The elephant in the room</span><span class="line"></span><span>Fig. 4.1</span></div>
  <div class="body">

        <h2 style="font-size:40px;color:var(--ochre)">The market lacks orchestrators.</h2>
        <p class="sub">The doom story says AI replaces analysts. The bigger picture: lots of new roles, skills changing fast, and employers who can't find people who can run the change.</p>
        <div class="card" style="margin-top:16px"><div class="t">Both things are true</div><p>More roles overall, <b>and</b> a higher first rung (Part 1). WEF also expects 92 million roles displaced by 2030.</p></div>
        <p class="src" style="margin-top:12px">WEF Future of Jobs 2025 · LinkedIn Work Change Report 2025</p>
      </div>

        <h1 style="font-size:44px">Skill 1: The orchestrator</h1>

        <div class="checks">

          <button class="chk" data-done><span class="bx">✓</span><span><h4>Systems choreography</h4><p>Make step two use step one's output, and check the handover.</p></span></button>

Fewer than a quarter let it run a whole workflow. <b>Orchestration is the rare skill.</b></p><div class="s">McKinsey Hong Kong survey · Jun 2026</div></div>
        <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:16px;margin-top:14px">If you can't describe the outcome, the AI can't build it.</p>

      <div><p class="sub" style="margin-top:4px">A high GPA gets your CV skimmed. <b>A working demo gets you hired.</b> Do the job before you have the title, and let the title catch up.</p><div class="adv-do"><span class="lab">This semester</span><b>Build one working demo.</b><span>Solve a real frustration with AI, in steps you designed. Your CV's best line.</span></div></div>

  <div class="body" data-tabs>
    <h1 style="font-size:44px">Skill 2: The smart designer</h1>
    <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0 14px">Governance architecture.</p>
    <div class="plate"><span class="figno">Fig. 1.9</span>

          <path class="ln ac lk" d="M-15,-18 V-32 A15,15 0 0 1 15,-32 V-18" style="fill:none"/><rect class="hit" x="-26" y="-20" width="52" height="44" rx="5"/>

          <text class="to" x="0" y="-60" text-anchor="middle" style="font-weight:600">INTENT AUDIT</text></g>
        <g class="lock" data-tab="c" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Safety valve" transform="translate(912,140)">
          <path class="ln ac lk" d="M-15,-18 V-32 A15,15 0 0 1 15,-32 V-18" style="fill:none"/><rect class="hit" x="-26" y="-20" width="52" height="44" rx="5"/>
          <circle class="key" cx="0" cy="-2" r="4.5"/><rect class="key" x="-2" y="0" width="4" height="12"/>
          <text class="to" x="0" y="-60" text-anchor="middle" style="font-weight:600">SAFETY VALVE</text></g>

    <div class="row" style="grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:34px;margin-top:16px;align-items:start;flex:none">
      <div><p class="shout">Do not re-perform.<br>Validate.</p><p class="sub" style="font-size:15px;margin-top:10px">In a world of infinite output, the scarce thing is <b>trust</b>. Design workflows that catch hallucinations.</p></div>
      <div>
        <div class="card warm" data-panel="a"><div class="t">Checkpoint 1 · human in the loop</div><p>A person approves before anything leaves. <b>Catches everything, but slow at scale</b>, so use it where a mistake would really hurt.</p></div>
        <div class="card warm" data-panel="b" hidden><div class="t">Checkpoint 2 · intent audit</div><p>Did it do what was asked? <b>Every claim has a source, totals reconcile, nothing outside scope.</b> This is where a second AI can check the first.</p></div>
        <div class="card warm" data-panel="c" hidden><div class="t">Checkpoint 3 · safety valve</div><p><b>Limits and an off switch</b>: a cap on value, who it may contact, and a way to stop it. My home agents in Part 3 run on rules like these.</p></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="advice" aria-hidden="true"><div class="adv-top"><span>My advice · skill 2 of 4</span><button class="zx" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>
    <div class="tiptall">
    <figure class="photo"><img src="img/tip4.jpg" alt="A coin, half circuit board, half cracked gold" loading="eager"><figcaption>Tip 2 · from my MSBA talk</figcaption></figure>
    <div>
      <h1>Tip 2: Build the currency of credibility.</h1>
      <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:20px;color:var(--ochre);margin-top:10px">True to your word once = trust. Persistently = credibility.</p>
      <p class="sub">When anyone can generate a convincing answer, the person whose work is <b>checked, sourced and delivered as promised</b> is rare. Guard it, in a group project or a global bank.</p>
      <div class="adv-do"><span class="lab">This semester</span><b>Keep a "how I checked it" log.</b><span>Two lines for anything AI helped you make: what you checked, what you found.</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  </div>
</section>

    <h1 style="font-size:44px">Skill 3: The synthetic polymath</h1>
    <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0 12px">Curiosity is your survival skill.</p>
    <div class="plate"><span class="figno">Fig. 1.10</span>

    <p class="sub" style="text-align:center;margin:8px auto 0;font-size:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:10px;max-width:70ch">Vibe coding requires knowing a little about everything. Where AI takes the routine, <b>roles that rely on judgement and breadth grew twice as fast</b> (PwC, 2026).</p>

  <div class="advice" aria-hidden="true"><div class="adv-top"><span>My advice · skill 3 of 4</span><button class="zx" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>

    <figure class="photo"><img src="img/tip2.jpg" alt="Close-up of a hand-made oak chair joint" loading="eager"><figcaption>Tip 3 · from my MSBA talk</figcaption></figure>
    <div>
      <h1>Tip 3: Features don't sell. Story does.</h1>
      <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:20px;color:var(--ochre);margin-top:10px">The wabi-sabi edge.</p>
      <p class="sub">AI generates pristine code in seconds. A human story creates the transformation. When you pitch, <b>sell the craftsmanship and the journey</b>, not the algorithm.</p>
      <div class="adv-do"><span class="lab">This semester</span><b>Tell its story in 60 seconds.</b><span>The problem, who it helps, what changed. Practise until it's natural.</span></div>
    </div>

      <div>
        <h1 style="font-size:44px">Skill 4: The human moat</h1>
        <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--ink2);margin:6px 0 18px">The unhackable skills.</p>
        <div class="card" data-panel="a"><div class="t">High-stakes accountability</div><p>Somebody signs the recommendation and answers for it to a client or a regulator. <b>"The AI decided" is never accepted.</b></p></div>
        <div class="card" data-panel="b" hidden><div class="t">Trust &amp; empathy</div><p>Clients buy from people they trust, especially when the news is bad. <b>A relationship is built over years, not generated.</b></p></div>
        <div class="card" data-panel="c" hidden><div class="t">Reading the room</div><p>Knowing what a client didn't say, when to stop talking, who in the meeting really decides. <b>None of it is in the data.</b></p></div>
        <p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:22px;margin-top:22px">"Age of AI requires HUMAN connection."</p>
        <div class="bigfig" style="margin-top:16px;max-width:440px"><div class="v">84%</div><p>of new graduates say people skills matter more as AI spreads.</p><div class="s">CFA Institute Graduate Outlook 2026</div></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="advice" aria-hidden="true"><div class="adv-top"><span>My advice · skill 4 of 4</span><button class="zx" aria-label="Close">×</button></div>
    <div class="tipwide">
    <figure class="photo fit"><img class="bg" src="img/tip1.jpg" alt=""><img class="fg" src="img/tip1.jpg" alt="An unspoken business frustration on one side, a generative AI solution on the other, joined by a golden fingerprint: the real translator" loading="eager"><figcaption>Tip 4 · from my MSBA talk</figcaption></figure>
    <div class="tx">
      <div><h1>Tip 4: Be the ultimate translator.</h1><p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--ochre);margin-top:8px">Connect first. Code second.</p></div>
      <div><p class="sub" style="margin-top:4px">An LLM translates a prompt into code, or 100 pages into a summary. It can't sit with a team and hear the frustration they never say out loud. <b>That translation is yours.</b></p><div class="adv-do"><span class="lab">This semester</span><b>Talk to one real user first.</b><span>Find a real frustration in a club, family business or internship before you build anything.</span></div></div>
    </div>

</section>

      <div><h1>Tip 5: Embrace the resistance.</h1><p class="mono-quote" style="font-size:19px;color:var(--ochre);margin-top:8px">You propel forward only when you feel friction.</p></div>
      <div><p class="sub" style="margin-top:4px">AI can remove every bit of friction from learning. <b>That's the trap.</b> Late nights and broken code aren't signs you're failing. They're proof you're moving.</p><div class="echo" style="margin-top:22px">Echoes Part 1 · <button data-echo="trap">cognitive debt ↩</button></div></div>

<div id="chrome">
  <span id="count">01 / 50</span><span id="secname">Opening</span><span id="clock">09:00</span>
  <div class="prog"><i id="progbar"></i></div>
  <span class="jump" id="jump"><button data-p="0">Open</button><button data-p="1">1</button><button data-p="2">2</button><button data-p="3">3</button><button data-p="4">4</button></span>
  <button id="btnBack" hidden>↩ Back (B)</button><button id="btnPrev" aria-label="Previous slide">←</button><button id="btnNext" aria-label="Next slide">→</button>
  <button id="btnNotes">Notes (N)</button><button id="btnTheme">◐ Theme</button><button id="btnFull">Full (F)</button>
</div>
<aside id="notes"><h5>Presenter notes</h5><div class="nb" id="notesBody"></div></aside>
<script>
(function(){
var slides=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.slide'));
var stage=document.getElementById('stage'),vpEl=document.getElementById('viewport'),i=0,backTo=null;
var SECN={'0':'Opening','1':'Part 1 · Missing rung','2':'Part 2 · Inside a bank','b':'Break','3':'Part 3 · Two doors & agents','4':'Part 4 · Survival kit'};
function $(id){return document.getElementById(id)}
function fit(){var pad=window.innerWidth<820?6:30;
  var s=Math.min((vpEl.clientWidth-pad*2)/1280,(vpEl.clientHeight-pad*2)/720);if(!(s>0))s=.1;
  stage.style.transform='translate(-50%,-50%) scale('+s+')';}
window.addEventListener('resize',fit);window.addEventListener('orientationchange',function(){setTimeout(fit,120)});fit();
function firstOf(p){for(var k=0;k<slides.length;k++)if(slides[k].getAttribute('data-part')===String(p))return k;return 0;}
function byId(id){for(var k=0;k<slides.length;k++)if(slides[k].getAttribute('data-id')===id)return k;return -1;}
function animate(sl){
  [].forEach.call(sl.querySelectorAll('.fill'),function(x){x.style.width='0'});
  [].forEach.call(sl.querySelectorAll('.cb'),function(x){x.style.height='0'});
  setTimeout(function(){
    [].forEach.call(sl.querySelectorAll('.fill'),function(x,n){setTimeout(function(){x.style.width=x.getAttribute('data-w')+'%'},n*140)});
    [].forEach.call(sl.querySelectorAll('.cb'),function(x,n){setTimeout(function(){x.style.height=(+x.getAttribute('data-h')/20*100)+'%'},n*260)});
  },140);}
function show(n){i=Math.max(0,Math.min(slides.length-1,n));
  slides.forEach(function(s,k){s.classList.toggle('on',k===i)});
  var p=slides[i].getAttribute('data-part')||'0';
  $('count').textContent=String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')+' / '+slides.length;
  $('secname').textContent=SECN[p]||'';
  $('progbar').style.width=((i+1)/slides.length*100)+'%';
  $('notesBody').innerHTML=slides[i].getAttribute('data-notes')||'<p>—</p>';
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#jump button'),function(b){b.classList.toggle('cur',b.getAttribute('data-p')===p)});
  if(backTo!==null&&i!==backTo&&slides[i].getAttribute('data-id')===null){}
  $('btnBack').hidden=(backTo===null);
  animate(slides[i]);
  document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('deck:slide',{detail:{i:i,el:slides[i]}}));
  [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('video'),function(v){if(!slides[i].contains(v)){try{v.pause()}catch(e){}}});}
function step(d){var cur=slides[i];
  if(d>0&&cur.dataset.next){var t=byId(cur.dataset.next);if(t>=0){show(t);return}}
  var n=i;do{n+=d}while(n>0&&n<slides.length-1&&slides[n].hasAttribute('data-skip'));show(n);}
$('btnNext').onclick=function(){step(1)};$('btnPrev').onclick=function(){step(-1)};
window.deck={slides:slides,get i(){return i},show:show,byId:byId,
  goId:function(id){var k=byId(id);if(k>=0)show(k)},
  echo:function(id){var k=byId(id);if(k>=0){backTo=i;show(k)}}};
$('btnNotes').onclick=function(){$('notes').classList.toggle('open')};
$('btnFull').onclick=function(){try{if(document.fullscreenElement)document.exitFullscreen();
  else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen)document.documentElement.requestFullscreen().catch(function(){})}catch(e){}};
$('btnBack').onclick=function(){var t=backTo;backTo=null;show(t)};
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#jump button'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){show(firstOf(b.getAttribute('data-p')))}});
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-goto]'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){show(firstOf(b.getAttribute('data-goto')))}});
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-echo]'),function(b){b.onclick=function(){var k=byId(b.getAttribute('data-echo'));if(k>=0){backTo=i;show(k)}}});

/* theme: follow the system until the presenter picks */
var themes=['system','light','dark'],ti=0;
try{var st=localStorage.getItem('mgrTheme');if(themes.indexOf(st)>0)ti=themes.indexOf(st)}catch(e){}
function applyTheme(){var t=themes[ti];if(t==='system')document.documentElement.removeAttribute('data-theme');
  else document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme',t);$('btnTheme').textContent='◐ '+(t==='system'?'Auto':t==='light'?'Light':'Dark');}
function flipTheme(){ti=(ti+1)%3;applyTheme();try{localStorage.setItem('mgrTheme',themes[ti])}catch(e){}}
$('btnTheme').onclick=flipTheme;applyTheme();

document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
  if(e.metaKey||e.ctrlKey||e.altKey)return;
  var tg=e.target&&e.target.tagName;if(tg==='INPUT'||tg==='TEXTAREA')return;
  if(e.key==='t'||e.key==='T'){flipTheme();return}
  if(e.key==='b'||e.key==='B'){if(backTo!==null)$('btnBack').click();return}
  if(e.key>='0'&&e.key<='4'){show(firstOf(e.key));return}
  if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='PageDown'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();step(1)}
  else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'||e.key==='PageUp'){e.preventDefault();step(-1)}
  else if(e.key==='n'||e.key==='N'){$('notes').classList.toggle('open')}
  else if(e.key==='f'||e.key==='F'){$('btnFull').click()}
  else if(e.key==='Home'){show(0)}else if(e.key==='End'){show(slides.length-1)}});
var tx=0,ty=0,tt=0;
vpEl.addEventListener('touchstart',function(e){if(e.touches.length!==1)return;tx=e.touches[0].clientX;ty=e.touches[0].clientY;tt=Date.now()},{passive:true});
vpEl.addEventListener('touchend',function(e){var t=e.changedTouches&&e.changedTouches[0];if(!t||Date.now()-tt>700)return;
  var dx=t.clientX-tx,dy=t.clientY-ty;if(Math.abs(dx)>42&&Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)*1.4)step(dx<0?1:-1)},{passive:true});
function tick(){var d=new Date();$('clock').textContent=String(d.getHours()).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(d.getMinutes()).padStart(2,'0')}
tick();setInterval(tick,20000);

/* generic tabs: buttons [data-tab] switch [data-panel] inside the same [data-tabs] */
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-tabs]'),function(box){
  var btns=[].slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('[data-tab]')),panels=[].slice.call(box.querySelectorAll('[data-panel]'));
  function sel(k){btns.forEach(function(b){b.classList.toggle('on',b.getAttribute('data-tab')===k)});
    panels.forEach(function(p){if(p.getAttribute('data-panel')!==k)p.setAttribute('hidden','');else p.removeAttribute('hidden')});
    box.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tab',{detail:k}));}
  btns.forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){sel(b.getAttribute('data-tab'))});
    b.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if((e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' ')&&b.tagName!=='BUTTON'){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();sel(b.getAttribute('data-tab'))}});});
  if(btns.length)sel(btns[0].getAttribute('data-tab'));});

/* reveal cards, show buttons, checklist */
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-reveal]'),function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){b.classList.toggle('shown')})});
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-show]'),function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){var t=document.querySelector(b.getAttribute('data-show'));if(t)t.hidden=false})});
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-done]'),function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){b.classList.toggle('done')})});

/* counters: click +1, shift-click −1; on the wall, the top three light up */
function hotWall(){var w=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('#wall .worry'));
  var vals=w.map(function(x){return +x.querySelector('.vn').textContent}).sort(function(a,b){return b-a});
  var cut=vals[2]||0;w.forEach(function(x){var v=+x.querySelector('.vn').textContent;x.classList.toggle('hot',v>0&&v>=cut)});}
function wireCount(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(e){var n=b.querySelector('.vn');var v=+n.textContent+(e.shiftKey?-1:1);
  n.textContent=Math.max(0,v);if(b.closest('#wall'))hotWall();})}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]'),wireCount);
var wf=$('wallForm');
if(wf)wf.addEventListener('submit',function(e){e.preventDefault();var v=$('wallIn').value.trim();if(!v)return;
  var b=document.createElement('button');b.className='worry';b.setAttribute('data-count','');
  var q=document.createElement('span');q.className='wq';q.textContent=v;
  var n=document.createElement('span');n.className='wn vn';n.textContent='0';
  b.appendChild(q);b.appendChild(n);$('wall').appendChild(b);wireCount(b);$('wallIn').value='';});

/* warm-up meter */
var MQ=['used AI for coursework','used AI for something that wasn’t study','checked an AI answer against a source','were taught the rules for using AI at work or uni'];
var meter=$('meter');
if(meter)MQ.forEach(function(q){var r=document.createElement('div');r.className='bar';r.style.gridTemplateColumns='330px 1fr 220px';
  r.innerHTML='<span style="font-size:16px;line-height:1.35">'+q+'</span><div class="track"><i class="fill" data-w="0" style="background:var(--blue)"></i><span class="lab"></span></div><span style="display:flex;gap:4px"></span>';
  var fill=r.querySelector('.fill'),lab=r.querySelector('.lab'),bx=r.lastChild;
  [['Few',15],['Half',50],['Most',85]].forEach(function(o){var b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn';b.textContent=o[0];b.style.padding='8px 12px';
    b.onclick=function(){[].forEach.call(bx.children,function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});b.classList.add('on');
      fill.setAttribute('data-w',o[1]);fill.style.width=o[1]+'%';lab.textContent=o[0];};bx.appendChild(b);});
  meter.appendChild(r);});

/* guess the number */
var gs=$('guess');
if(gs){var picked=null;[].forEach.call(gs.children,function(b){b.onclick=function(){[].forEach.call(gs.children,function(x){x.classList.remove('on')});b.classList.add('on');picked=b}});
  $('guessGo').onclick=function(){[].forEach.call(gs.children,function(x){var ok=x.getAttribute('data-g')==='60';x.classList.remove('on');
    x.classList.toggle('right',ok);x.classList.toggle('wrong',!ok)});$('guessAns').hidden=false;};}

/* ladder */
var lad=$('ladder');
if(lad){var R=[['Data entry & formatting'],['First-draft research'],['Basic models & code'],['Checking & judging'],['Client advice & sign-off']];
  var els=R.map(function(r,k){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='rung';d.style.bottom=(14+k*76)+'px';lad.appendChild(d);return d});
  function setLad(y){els.forEach(function(d,k){d.className='rung';
    if(y==='b'&&k<3){d.className='rung gone';d.innerHTML=R[k][0]+'<span class="who">· agents</span>';}
    else if(y==='b'&&k===3){d.className='rung new';d.innerHTML='Your first rung: checking &amp; judging';}
    else d.textContent=R[k][0];});}
  lad.closest('[data-tabs]').addEventListener('tab',function(e){setLad(e.detail)});setLad('a');}

/* two doors */
var DIM=[
 {n:'Risk',p:['Your own work','If it is wrong, you notice and fix it. One person, one document.'],c:['Customers, money, regulators','If it is wrong at scale, someone else finds out first.'],v:'<b>The rules are proportionate</b> to who gets hurt when it breaks.'},

/* YouTube clips: the player loads only when you press play, and stops when you leave the slide */
var inArtifact=/claude/.test(location.hostname);
function ytSrc(el,auto){return 'https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/'+el.dataset.yt+'?start='+el.dataset.start+'&end='+el.dataset.end+
  '&rel=0&modestbranding=1&playsinline=1&vq=hd1080'+(auto?'&autoplay=1':'');}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.yt[data-yt]'),function(el){
  var a=el.querySelector('.yt-open');if(a)a.href='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+el.dataset.yt+'&t='+el.dataset.start+'s';
  var b=el.querySelector('.yt-play');if(!b)return;
  b.onclick=function(){if(inArtifact){window.open(a.href,'_blank','noopener');return}
    var f=document.createElement('iframe');f.src=ytSrc(el,true);f.allow='autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen';f.allowFullscreen=true;
    f.title='Video clip';el.querySelector('.yt-frame').appendChild(f);el.classList.add('playing');ytSize(f);};});
/* YouTube picks quality from the player's own layout size, which ignores the stage's scale().
   So lay the player out at least 1920 wide (or at true screen pixels, if bigger) and scale it
   down to fit the frame; YouTube then streams 1080p instead of 360p. */
function ytSize(f){var fr=f.parentNode,w=fr.offsetWidth;if(!w)return;
  var screenW=fr.getBoundingClientRect().width*(window.devicePixelRatio||1),W=Math.max(1920,Math.round(screenW)),k=w/W;
  f.style.cssText='width:'+W+'px;height:'+Math.round(W*9/16)+'px;transform:scale('+k+');transform-origin:0 0;inset:auto;left:0;top:0';}
window.addEventListener('resize',function(){[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.yt.playing iframe'),ytSize)});
/* chapters: a [data-s][data-e] button sets the clip's range; the room's vote picks one ('chapter' event) */
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.yt[data-yt]'),function(el){var cs=[].slice.call(el.querySelectorAll('.chap'));if(!cs.length)return;
  function pick(b){cs.forEach(function(x){x.classList.toggle('on',x===b)});el.dataset.start=b.dataset.s;el.dataset.end=b.dataset.e;
    var a=el.querySelector('.yt-open');if(a)a.href='https://www.youtube.com/watch?v='+el.dataset.yt+'&t='+el.dataset.start+'s';
    var f=el.querySelector('iframe');if(f)f.src=ytSrc(el,true);}
  cs.forEach(function(b){b.addEventListener('click',function(){pick(b)})});
  el.addEventListener('chapter',function(e){if(cs[e.detail])pick(cs[e.detail])});});
/* advice pop-ups: the button opens the tip over its skill slide; ×, Esc or leaving the slide closes it */
function advice(s,on){var a=s&&s.querySelector('.advice');if(!a)return;a.classList.toggle('in',on);a.setAttribute('aria-hidden',on?'false':'true');
  var b=s.querySelector('[data-advice]');if(b)b.classList.toggle('on',on);}
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-advice]'),function(b){var s=b.closest('.slide');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){advice(s,!s.querySelector('.advice').classList.contains('in'))});
  s.querySelector('.advice .zx').addEventListener('click',function(){advice(s,false)});});
document.addEventListener('deck:slide',function(){[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.advice.in'),function(a){advice(a.closest('.slide'),false)})});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape')[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.advice.in'),function(a){advice(a.closest('.slide'),false)})});
document.addEventListener('deck:slide',function(e){[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('.yt.playing'),function(el){
  if(!e.detail.el.contains(el)){var f=el.querySelector('iframe');if(f)f.remove();el.classList.remove('playing')}});});

/* CHO intro clip: one click plays it; leaving the slide pauses it */
(function(){var c=document.getElementById('choClip');if(!c)return;var v=c.querySelector('video'),b=c.querySelector('.clip-play');
  b.addEventListener('click',function(){c.classList.add('playing');v.play()});
  v.addEventListener('play',function(){c.classList.add('playing')});
  document.addEventListener('deck:slide',function(e){if(!e.detail.el.contains(c)&&!v.paused){v.pause()}});})();
/* videos: each video slide stands alone; show the fallback when the file isn't next to the deck */

  el('path',{d:'M'+(d.x+w)+','+t+' L'+(d.x+w+24)+','+(t-16)+' V'+(B-16)+' L'+(d.x+w)+','+B+' Z',style:'fill:var(--ink2);stroke:var(--blue)'},mb);

  el('path',{d:'M'+(d.x+w*.72)+','+t+' L'+(d.x+w*.62)+','+(t+d.h*.3)+' L'+(d.x+w*.8)+','+(t+d.h*.55)+' L'+(d.x+w*.66)+','+B,class:'glow'},mb);
  tx(mb,d.x+12,t+46,d.v,{style:'font-family:var(--serif);font-size:40px;fill:var(--onaccent);letter-spacing:-.02em'});
  tx(mb,d.x+12,t+70,d.a,{style:'font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;fill:var(--onaccent);letter-spacing:0'});
  tx(mb,d.x+12,t+86,d.b,{style:'font-family:var(--sans);font-size:11.5px;fill:var(--onaccent);letter-spacing:0'});
  tx(mb,d.x+12,t+104,d.c,{style:'font-family:var(--mono);font-size:9.5px;fill:var(--onaccent);letter-spacing:.06em;opacity:.8'});});}

(function(){
/* ══ pixel sprite engine — same shape as the CHO starter kit ══ */
var Sprite=(function(){
var BODY=['.....HHHHHH.....','...HHHHHHHHHH...','..HHHHHHHHHHHH..','..HHSSSSSSSSHH..',
'..HSSSSSSSSSSH..','..HSSEESSEESSH..','..HSSSSSSSSSSH..','..HSSSSMMSSSSH..',
'..HSSSSSSSSSSH..','...HSSSSSSSSH...','.....SSSSSS.....','...CCCCCCCCCC...',
'..CCCCCCCCCCCC..','.CCCCCAAAACCCCC.','.CCCCCAAAACCCCC.','.CCCCCCCCCCCCCC.',
'.CCCCCCCCCCCCCC.','..CCCCCCCCCCCC..','..PPPPPPPPPPPP..','..PPPPPPPPPPPP..',
'..PPPP....PPPP..','..PPPP....PPPP..','..KKKK....KKKK..','.KKKKK....KKKKK.'];
var EYES={open:'..HSSEESSEESSH..',shut:'..HSSKKSSKKSSH..'};
var MOUTH={closed:'..HSSSSMMSSSSH..',open:'..HSSSMMMMSSSH..',none:'..HSSSSSSSSSSH..'};
var LEGS={t:['..PPPP....PPPP..','..PPPP....PPPP..','..KKKK....KKKK..','.KKKKK....KKKKK.'],
 a:['.PPPP......PPPP.','.PPPP......PPPP.','.KKKK......KKKK.','KKKKK......KKKKK']};
var ARMS={
 idle:[[[0,13,'C'],[0,14,'C'],[0,15,'S'],[15,13,'C'],[15,14,'C'],[15,15,'S']],
       [[0,14,'C'],[0,15,'C'],[0,16,'S'],[15,14,'C'],[15,15,'C'],[15,16,'S']]],
 work:[[[0,13,'C'],[1,14,'C'],[2,15,'S'],[15,13,'C'],[14,14,'C'],[13,15,'S']],
       [[0,13,'C'],[1,14,'C'],[2,14,'S'],[15,13,'C'],[14,14,'C'],[13,14,'S']]],
 talk:[[[0,12,'S'],[0,13,'C'],[0,14,'C'],[15,13,'C'],[15,14,'C'],[15,15,'S']],
       [[0,11,'S'],[0,12,'C'],[0,13,'C'],[15,13,'C'],[15,14,'C'],[15,15,'S']]],
 sleep:[[[0,15,'C'],[0,16,'S'],[15,15,'C'],[15,16,'S']],
        [[0,15,'C'],[0,16,'S'],[15,15,'C'],[15,16,'S']]],
 walk:[[[0,12,'C'],[0,13,'C'],[0,14,'S'],[15,14,'C'],[15,15,'C'],[15,16,'S']],
       [[0,14,'C'],[0,15,'C'],[0,16,'S'],[15,12,'C'],[15,13,'C'],[15,14,'S']]]};
var PAL=[
 {H:'#4a3d6b',C:'#7c6ae0',A:'#5f4fc4',S:'#f2c9a0',P:'#3a3160'},
 {H:'#2a1a10',C:'#e0649a',A:'#b34d7d',S:'#c68a5a',P:'#4a3550'},
 {H:'#2c2018',C:'#d9a520',A:'#a87f14',S:'#f5d5a8',P:'#3d3a56'},
 {H:'#c8c8c8',C:'#5b86b4',A:'#3f6a97',S:'#f8d8c0',P:'#3a3160'},
 {H:'#1e1410',C:'#4caf50',A:'#357a38',S:'#d8a878',P:'#33405a'},
 {H:'#6a3820',C:'#e07a5f',A:'#b85c44',S:'#f0c8a8',P:'#4a3c5e'},
 {H:'#151515',C:'#3d5a80',A:'#2c4360',S:'#7a4a28',P:'#2e3b52'},
 {H:'#3a3a3a',C:'#c08a29',A:'#8f5e0e',S:'#b07850',P:'#3c3654'},
 {H:'#1a1a22',C:'#2aa198',A:'#1d7a72',S:'#f0c8a0',P:'#33405a'},
 {H:'#5a2f2f',C:'#c96f4a',A:'#9b5133',S:'#e8bd93',P:'#3f3556'}];
var BASE={E:'#241d38',M:'#b8564f',K:'#241d38'};
var reduce=false;
try{reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches}catch(e){}

function draw(cx,ox,oy,S,pal,state,t,seed){
  var P={},k;for(k in BASE)P[k]=BASE[k];for(k in pal)P[k]=pal[k];
  var slow=state==='work'?170:state==='walk'?150:620;
  var f=Math.floor((t+seed*977)/slow)%2;
  var bob=(state==='sleep'||state==='work')?0:f;
  var rows=BODY.slice();
  var blink=(t+seed*1300)%4000>3820;
  rows[5]=(state==='sleep'||state==='work'||blink)?EYES.shut:EYES.open;
  rows[7]=state==='sleep'?MOUTH.none:(state==='talk'?(Math.floor(t/170)%2?MOUTH.open:MOUTH.closed):MOUTH.closed);
  if(state==='walk'){var lg=f?LEGS.a:LEGS.t;for(var n=0;n<4;n++)rows[20+n]=lg[n];}
  var px=function(x,y,c){if(!c)return;cx.fillStyle=c;
    cx.fillRect((ox+x)*S,(oy+y+bob)*S,S,S);};
  rows.forEach(function(row,y){for(var x=0;x<16;x++)px(x,y,P[row[x]]);});
  (ARMS[state]||ARMS.idle)[f].forEach(function(a){px(a[0],a[1],P[a[2]])});
  if(state==='sleep'){var z=Math.floor(t/620)%3;
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(200,192,230,.85)';cx.font=(S*3)+'px ui-monospace, monospace';
    cx.fillText('z',(ox+15)*S,(oy+3-z)*S);}
  if(state==='work'&&Math.floor((t+seed*400)/320)%2)px(8,-2,'#f2c14e');
}
var jobs=[];
function register(canvas,fn){var j={c:canvas,fn:fn,v:false};jobs.push(j);
  try{new IntersectionObserver(function(es){es.forEach(function(e){j.v=e.isIntersecting})},
    {rootMargin:'100px'}).observe(canvas)}catch(e){j.v=true}
  fn(0);return j;}
var last=0;
function tick(t){if(!reduce&&t-last>55){last=t;
  for(var n=0;n<jobs.length;n++)if(jobs[n].v)jobs[n].fn(t);}
  requestAnimationFrame(tick);}
requestAnimationFrame(tick);
return {draw:draw,register:register,PAL:PAL};
})();


[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-sprite]'),function(cv,n){
  var S=+(cv.dataset.scale||3),state=cv.dataset.sprite;var pal=Sprite.PAL[(+cv.dataset.pal||0)%Sprite.PAL.length];
  cv.width=16*S;cv.height=27*S;cv.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');var cx=cv.getContext('2d');cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  Sprite.register(cv,function(t){cx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);Sprite.draw(cx,0,2,S,pal,state,t,n*5+1);});});
/* ══ the office ══ */
(function(){
var cv=document.getElementById('officeCanvas');if(!cv)return;
var cx=cv.getContext('2d');cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
var S=4,W=Math.floor(cv.width/S),H=Math.floor(cv.height/S);
var STAFF=[
 {n:'Kenji',x:6,y:24,pal:8,prop:'plant'},
 {n:'Priya',x:50,y:24,pal:1,prop:'flower'},
 {n:'Ingrid',x:94,y:24,pal:3,prop:'mug'},
 {n:'Rosa',x:138,y:24,pal:4,prop:'plant'},
 {n:'Ade',x:182,y:24,pal:7,prop:'chart'}];
var night=false,walkX=8,dir=1,FLOOR=52;
function rect(x,y,w,h,c){cx.fillStyle=c;cx.fillRect(x*S,y*S,w*S,h*S);}
function room(t){
  rect(0,0,W,FLOOR,night?'#221c3d':'#3a3266');
  [[18,5],[86,5],[154,5]].forEach(function(w){
    rect(w[0]-2,w[1]-2,22,17,night?'#171331':'#2b2550');
    rect(w[0],w[1],18,13,night?'#0f0c22':'#7fb4e8');
    if(night){for(var i=0;i<6;i++){
      rect(w[0]+((i*7+w[0])%17),w[1]+((i*5+w[0])%12),1,1,(t/400+i)%4>2?'#fff':'#9a92c8');}
      rect(w[0]+11,w[1]+2,4,4,'#e8e2c0');rect(w[0]+12,w[1]+2,3,3,'#0f0c22');
    }else{rect(w[0]+2,w[1]+8,14,5,'#a8d0a0');rect(w[0]+12,w[1]+1,3,3,'#f6e58d');}});
  rect(0,FLOOR,W,H-FLOOR,night?'#1a1531':'#2c2450');
  for(var x=0;x<W;x+=10)rect(x,FLOOR,5,1,night?'#241d42':'#3a3160');
  rect(0,FLOOR,W,1,night?'#100d24':'#241d42');
  var cp=W-13;rect(cp,4,7,7,'#e8e2f5');rect(cp+1,5,5,5,night?'#2a2348':'#4b4180');
  rect(cp+3,6,1,2,'#e8e2f5');rect(cp+3,7,night?1:2,1,'#e8e2f5');
}
function desk(x,y,prop,lit,t){
  var d=x+15;
  rect(d,y+17,20,2,'#544878');rect(d,y+19,20,1,'#3b3260');
  rect(d+3,y+20,2,4,'#332b57');rect(d+15,y+20,2,4,'#332b57');
  rect(d+4,y+10,8,7,'#1c1830');
  rect(d+5,y+11,6,5,lit?'#7ee0a8':'#2f2a4d');
  if(lit&&Math.floor(t/700)%2)rect(d+5,y+11,6,1,'#a8f0c8');
  if(prop==='plant'){rect(d+16,y+14,3,3,'#8a5a3a');rect(d+17,y+11,1,3,'#4f9c5c');rect(d+16,y+12,3,1,'#4f9c5c');}
  if(prop==='flower'){rect(d+16,y+14,3,3,'#8a5a3a');rect(d+17,y+12,1,2,'#4f9c5c');rect(d+16,y+11,3,1,'#f0a030');}
  if(prop==='mug'){rect(d+16,y+15,3,2,'#e8e2f5');}
  if(prop==='chart'){rect(d+15,y+12,1,5,'#5fd68a');rect(d+17,y+14,1,3,'#f2c14e');rect(d+19,y+13,1,4,'#e8615a');}
}
function shadow(x,y){rect(x+2,y+24,12,1,'rgba(10,6,26,.35)');}
function frame(t){
  cx.clearRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);room(t);
  STAFF.forEach(function(s,n){
    var st=night?(s.n==='Kenji'?'work':'sleep'):(n%3===1?'idle':'work');
    shadow(s.x,s.y);
    Sprite.draw(cx,s.x,s.y,S,Sprite.PAL[s.pal],st,t,n+1);
    desk(s.x,s.y,s.prop,st==='work',t);});
  if(!night){
    walkX+=dir*0.22;if(walkX>W-26)dir=-1;if(walkX<4)dir=1;
    shadow(Math.round(walkX),FLOOR+2);
    cx.save();
    if(dir<0){cx.translate((Math.round(walkX)*2+16)*S,0);cx.scale(-1,1);}
    Sprite.draw(cx,Math.round(walkX),FLOOR+2,S,Sprite.PAL[5],'walk',t,9);
    cx.restore();}
  if(night){cx.fillStyle='rgba(24,18,52,.34)';cx.fillRect(0,0,cv.width,cv.height);}
}
Sprite.register(cv,frame);
[].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#officeBar button'),function(b){
  b.onclick=function(){
    night=b.dataset.mode==='night';
    [].forEach.call(document.querySelectorAll('#officeBar button'),function(x){
      x.classList.toggle('on',x===b)});
    document.getElementById('officeCap').textContent=night
      ?'Night shift. Everyone asleep except the one job that re-reads the whole week — and nobody is waiting for it.'
      :'Daytime. Everyone at their desk, Marcelo doing his rounds, the machine quietly reading my life.';
    frame(performance.now());};});
})();

})();
